sec14-card-sec14-F12.expected_back: The guide groups collision contributors into equipment problems, roadway design, road maintenance and driver behavior.

sec14-card-sec14-F13.front: Which three mechanical vehicle systems can contribute directly to a crash when neglected?
sec14-card-sec14-F13.expected_back: Unsafe tires, braking or steering faults can contribute to a collision.

sec14-card-sec14-F14.front: Which three roadway maintenance or work-zone conditions create sudden collision hazards?
sec14-card-sec14-F14.expected_back: Road debris, potholes and construction can create collision hazards.

sec14-card-sec14-F15.front: Which four driver behaviors does the guide spotlight as prime collision hazards?
sec14-card-sec14-F15.expected_back: Tailgating, unsafe lane changes, speeding and failing to yield are hazardous driver behaviors.

sec14-card-sec14-F16.front: Where should heavy or loose cargo ride whenever possible, and why?
sec14-card-sec14-F16.expected_back: Store loose objects in the trunk when possible so they are less likely to strike occupants in a collision.

sec14-card-sec14-F17.front: Which three groups of items belong inside a prepared driver's collision kit?
sec14-card-sec14-F17.expected_back: The guide recommends keeping writing materials, insurance details and emergency supplies in a collision kit.

sec14-card-sec14-F18.front: Why check your owner's manual before an emergency stop ever tests your brakes?
sec14-card-sec14-F18.expected_back: Know which braking system the vehicle has; the owner’s manual can identify anti-lock equipment.

sec14-card-sec14-F19.front: How do anti-lock brakes help a driver during an emergency stop?
sec14-card-sec14-F19.expected_back: Anti-lock braking helps preserve steering control by managing wheel lockup.

sec14-card-sec14-F20.front: What does an ABS dashboard warning lamp tell you when it stays lit after startup?
sec14-card-sec14-F20.expected_back: A persistent ABS warning lamp indicates that the system needs attention.

sec14-card-sec14-F21.front: If an oncoming car drifts into your lane, which escape direction must you avoid?
sec14-card-sec14-F21.expected_back: If an approaching vehicle enters the driver’s lane, avoid escaping into the opposing lane.

sec14-card-sec14-F22.front: Why does the guide require buckling your lap-and-shoulder belt on every single trip?
sec14-card-sec14-F22.expected_back: Wear the lap-and-shoulder belt before every trip as protection if a collision cannot be avoided.

sec14-card-sec14-F23.front: How can a sideways-sliding vehicle end up rolling over?
sec14-card-sec14-F23.expected_back: A sideways-sliding vehicle can roll when a curb, soft ground or another obstruction trips it.

sec14-card-sec14-F24.front: How does a higher center of gravity change a vehicle's rollover behavior?
sec14-card-sec14-F24.expected_back: A higher center of gravity makes a vehicle more prone to tipping.

sec14-card-sec14-F25.front: Which two driver inputs commonly trigger vehicle rollovers?
sec14-card-sec14-F25.expected_back: Excess speed and abrupt steering can contribute to a rollover.

sec14-card-sec14-F26.front: How should you recover if your tires drop off the edge of the paved roadway?
sec14-card-sec14-F26.expected_back: If the vehicle leaves the pavement, slow gradually rather than jerking the steering wheel back toward the road.

sec14-card-sec14-F27.front: What deadly rollover outcome do fastened safety belts help prevent?
sec14-card-sec14-F27.expected_back: Belts help prevent occupants from being ejected during a rollover.

sec14-card-sec14-F28.front: How do modern side airbag systems help shield riders when a vehicle tips?
sec14-card-sec14-F28.expected_back: Some side airbags use rollover sensors to help protect occupants during a rollover.

sec14-card-sec14-F29.front: What happens when you turn sharply or brake abruptly on wet or icy pavement?
sec14-card-sec14-F29.expected_back: Abrupt turning or stopping on a slippery surface can cause a skid.

sec14-card-sec14-F30.front: When the rear of your vehicle slides sideways, how should you steer?
sec14-card-sec14-F30.expected_back: In the guide’s rear-skid example, turn toward the direction in which the rear is sliding without oversteering.

sec14-card-sec14-F31.front: Why might two different vehicles react differently to braking and steering inputs?
sec14-card-sec14-F31.expected_back: Braking and steering responses can vary with the vehicle’s drive and control systems.

sec14-card-sec14-F32.front: During traction loss, how should you steer and where should you aim your eyes?
sec14-card-sec14-F32.expected_back: Avoid abrupt steering during traction loss and look toward the desired travel path.

sec14-card-sec14-F33.front: How does electronic stability control detect a slide and help keep the vehicle straight?
sec14-card-sec14-F33.expected_back: Electronic stability control compares the intended direction with actual vehicle travel and can apply individual brakes to help maintain stability.

sec14-card-sec14-F34.front: What three rules govern steering, brakes, and throttle when your tires hydroplane on water?
sec14-card-sec14-F34.expected_back: When hydroplaning, avoid a sudden turn or sudden braking and ease off the accelerator.

sec14-card-sec14-F35.front: What is your top priority if your car stalls on railroad tracks with a train approaching?
sec14-card-sec14-F35.expected_back: If trapped on tracks with a train approaching, get all occupants out and away from the rail path.

sec14-card-sec14-R01.front: At the instant a tire blows out, what must you do with the wheel and brake pedal?
sec14-card-sec14-R01.expected_back: During a tire blowout, hold the wheel firmly and avoid slamming on the brakes.

sec14-card-sec14-R02.front: Once a vehicle with a blown tire slows under control, how do you finish stopping?
sec14-card-sec14-R02.expected_back: After a blowout, keep the vehicle controlled as it slows, then brake gently and stop in a safe place.

sec14-card-sec14-R03.front: If your accelerator sticks open, where do your eyes stay and what gear do you select?
sec14-card-sec14-R03.expected_back: If the accelerator sticks, keep watching the road and shift into neutral.

sec14-card-sec14-R04.front: What critical mistake must you avoid while stopping a vehicle with a stuck accelerator?
sec14-card-sec14-R04.expected_back: Do not engage a steering-lock mechanism while trying to stop a vehicle with a stuck accelerator.

sec14-card-sec14-R05.front: Why must you avoid yanking or stomping the parking brake abruptly if main service brakes fail?
sec14-card-sec14-R05.expected_back: If the service brakes fail, avoid suddenly applying the parking brake because this can cause loss of control.

sec14-card-sec14-R06.front: Once a vehicle with failed brakes finally stops, may you limp it home slowly?
sec14-card-sec14-R06.expected_back: A vehicle without working brakes must not be driven further; call for assistance.

sec14-card-sec14-R07.front: What trouble does steam billowing from under the hood signal, and what two steps come first?
sec14-card-sec14-R07.expected_back: Steam from under the hood can indicate overheating; stop safely and switch off the engine.

sec14-card-sec14-R08.front: Why must your hands stay off a radiator cap right after an engine overheats?
sec14-card-sec14-R08.expected_back: Do not open a hot radiator cap; allow the engine to cool.

sec14-card-sec14-R09.front: What four-step sequence handles smoke coming from beneath your hood?
sec14-card-sec14-R09.expected_back: If smoke comes from under the hood, leave traffic, stop, shut off the engine and get occupants away from the vehicle.

sec14-card-sec14-R10.front: Should a driver try battling a large vehicle fire personally?
sec14-card-sec14-R10.expected_back: Do not attempt to fight a large vehicle fire; obtain assistance.

sec14-card-sec14-R11.front: Why are cigarettes, matches, and open flames banned around a vehicle battery?
sec14-card-sec14-R11.expected_back: A vehicle battery can release explosive fumes, so do not smoke or use a flame nearby.

sec14-card-sec14-R12.front: At the very first sign your car is failing, how should you use remaining momentum?
sec14-card-sec14-R12.expected_back: At the first sign of a breakdown, ease off the accelerator and move smoothly toward a safe roadside location.

sec14-card-sec14-R13.front: What two traffic habits still apply while steering a failing vehicle out of its lane?
sec14-card-sec14-R13.expected_back: Signal intentions and check traffic carefully when moving a failing vehicle out of its lane.

sec14-card-sec14-R14.front: Once parked safely off the road, how do you warn approaching motorists?
sec14-card-sec14-R14.expected_back: Once safely stopped, make the vehicle visible with hazard lamps or reflective warning equipment.

sec14-card-sec14-R15.front: Where around a broken-down roadside vehicle must you never stand?
sec14-card-sec14-R15.expected_back: Do not stand immediately behind or alongside a broken-down vehicle exposed to traffic.

sec14-card-sec14-R16.front: If your disabled car cannot clear a live travel lane, where should occupants stay while help arrives?
sec14-card-sec14-R16.expected_back: If the disabled vehicle remains in the traffic lane, wait away from it while help is sought.

sec14-card-sec14-R17.front: When your disabled car sits well clear of traffic, what does the guide advise doing?
sec14-card-sec14-R17.expected_back: When the vehicle is safely clear of traffic, the guide recommends waiting inside with doors locked and calling for help.

sec14-card-sec14-R18.front: Should you stand roadside trying to wave down passing traffic for breakdown help?
sec14-card-sec14-R18.expected_back: Do not try to wave passing vehicles down for assistance.

sec14-card-sec14-R19.front: Why can vehicle exhaust poison cabin occupants without them noticing a scent?
sec14-card-sec14-R19.expected_back: Carbon monoxide from vehicle exhaust has no smell and can affect occupants without an obvious odor warning.

sec14-card-sec14-R20.front: Which two common situations let dangerous carbon monoxide build up around occupants?
sec14-card-sec14-R20.expected_back: A leaking exhaust or an engine running in a confined garage can permit carbon monoxide to accumulate.

sec14-card-sec14-R21.front: What immediate action does the guide direct if anyone suspects exhaust-gas poisoning?
sec14-card-sec14-R21.expected_back: The guide directs a person suspecting exhaust-gas poisoning to get fresh air immediately.

sec14-card-sec14-R22.front: What must you do whenever floodwater covers the roadway ahead?
sec14-card-sec14-R22.expected_back: Do not attempt to drive through a flooded roadway; turn back and select another route.

sec14-card-sec14-R23.front: Why can even shallow-looking floodwater over a road still wreck or trap your vehicle?
sec14-card-sec14-R23.expected_back: Floodwater can hide a damaged or washed-out road even when the water looks shallow.

sec14-card-sec14-R24.front: If floodwater blocks your path and no detour exists, where should you go?
sec14-card-sec14-R24.expected_back: If no alternate route is available, wait on higher ground for floodwater to recede.

sec14-card-sec14-R25.front: If your vehicle plunges into deep water, when must occupants start escaping?
sec14-card-sec14-R25.expected_back: If a vehicle enters water, the guide directs occupants to begin escaping immediately instead of waiting inside.

sec14-card-sec14-R26.front: What three survival steps in order does the guide's water-escape cue POGO stand for?
sec14-card-sec14-R26.expected_back: The guide’s water-escape cue POGO means releasing belts, opening windows and getting out.

sec14-card-sec14-R27.front: After any crash causing injury, death, or property damage, what must you do instead of driving off?
sec14-card-sec14-R27.expected_back: After a collision involving injury, death or damage, stop when safe and identify yourself rather than leaving the scene.

sec14-card-sec14-R28.front: Which two emergency services should you summon after a crash when injuries may exist?
sec14-card-sec14-R28.expected_back: Request police assistance after a collision and an ambulance when needed.

sec14-card-sec14-R29.front: Whose names and details should you gather at the scene of a crash?
sec14-card-sec14-R29.expected_back: Collect involved persons’ names and witness details after a crash.

sec14-card-sec14-R30.front: Which details must crash-involved drivers exchange, and what card must be presented on request?
sec14-card-sec14-R30.expected_back: Drivers must exchange their name, address and vehicle identification details and show a license when requested.

sec14-card-sec14-R31.front: What three duties apply if you strike an unattended parked car or roadside property?
sec14-card-sec14-R31.expected_back: If an unattended vehicle or property is damaged, notify police, seek the owner and leave identifying contact information.

sec14-card-sec14-R32.front: Which six travel, occupant, timestamp, and weather facts should you write down after a collision?
sec14-card-sec14-R32.expected_back: Document travel direction, lane, occupants, date, time and weather after a crash.

sec14-card-sec14-R33.front: How soon after a traffic collision should you notify your insurance company?
sec14-card-sec14-R33.expected_back: Notify the insurer as soon as practical after a collision.

sec14-card-sec14-R34.front: When is moving an injured person after a collision justified?
sec14-card-sec14-R34.expected_back: Do not move an injured person unless an immediate life-threatening danger requires it.

sec14-card-sec14-R35.front: Which four steps secure a vehicle before you walk away and leave it unattended?
sec14-card-sec14-R35.memory_hook: Stop engine, lock ignition, key, brake
sec14-card-sec14-R35.expected_back: Before leaving a vehicle unattended, stop the engine, secure the ignition, remove the key and apply the brake.

sec14-card-sec14-R36.front: What three actions are required when an authorized emergency vehicle approaches using warning signals?
sec14-card-sec14-R36.expected_back: For an approaching authorized emergency vehicle using warning signals, yield, move toward the right edge and stop until it passes.

sec14-card-sec14-R37.front: On a multilane highway approaching a stopped emergency vehicle, when do you change into a nonadjacent lane?
sec14-card-sec14-R37.expected_back: On a multilane road near a stopped emergency vehicle, change into a nonadjacent lane only when that can be done safely.

sec14-card-sec14-R38.front: What must you do passing a stopped emergency vehicle when changing lanes is unsafe or impossible?
sec14-card-sec14-R38.expected_back: If moving over is unsafe or impossible, slow to a reasonably safe speed for the conditions.

sec15-card-sec15-F01.front: Under Louisiana law, how serious is driving while impaired by alcohol or certain drugs?
sec15-card-sec15-F01.expected_back: Operating a vehicle while impaired by alcohol or certain drugs is a crime.

sec15-card-sec15-F02.front: Is alcohol pharmacologically classified as a stimulant or as a depressant?
sec15-card-sec15-F02.expected_back: Alcohol is a depressant rather than a stimulant.

sec15-card-sec15-F03.front: Which four core driving abilities suffer after consuming alcohol?
sec15-card-sec15-F03.expected_back: Alcohol can slow reflexes, impair judgment, reduce alertness and affect vision.

sec15-card-sec15-F04.front: Why do people sometimes feel energized right after drinking even though alcohol is a depressant?
sec15-card-sec15-F04.expected_back: Lowered inhibition after drinking can create a misleading feeling of stimulation.

sec15-card-sec15-F05.front: Does switching between beer, wine, and liquor change impairment, or what truly governs the effect?
sec15-card-sec15-F05.expected_back: The amount of alcohol reaching the blood matters rather than whether the beverage is beer, wine or spirits.

sec15-card-sec15-F06.front: Which two drinking and meal factors change how quickly alcohol enters the bloodstream?
sec15-card-sec15-F06.expected_back: Food intake and drinking rate can affect how rapidly alcohol is absorbed.

sec15-card-sec15-F07.front: Can hot coffee, working out, or a cold shower sober up an impaired driver?
sec15-card-sec15-F07.expected_back: Coffee, exercise and cold showers do not make an impaired person sober.

sec15-card-sec15-F08.front: What is the sole factor that clears alcohol out of the body?
sec15-card-sec15-F08.expected_back: Eliminating alcohol takes time rather than a quick sobering trick.

sec15-card-sec15-F09.front: Which three spatial judgments needed in traffic get distorted by alcohol?
sec15-card-sec15-F09.expected_back: Alcohol can impair judging speed, distance and angles.

sec15-card-sec15-F10.front: How does drinking change a driver's sense of caution toward traffic laws?
sec15-card-sec15-F10.expected_back: Drinking can reduce caution and encourage unsafe risks or traffic violations.

sec15-card-sec15-F11.front: What everyday vehicle controls can an alcohol-impaired driver forget to use when concentration drops?
sec15-card-sec15-F11.expected_back: Alcohol-impaired concentration can lead a driver to omit signals, lights or other driving tasks.

sec15-card-sec15-F12.front: Which two fundamental traffic maneuvers suffer from alcohol-slowed driver responses?
sec15-card-sec15-F12.expected_back: Alcohol can slow the response needed for a stop or turn.

sec15-card-sec15-F13.front: Why should someone who has been drinking never trust their own sense of fitness to drive?
sec15-card-sec15-F13.expected_back: An impaired person may misjudge the degree of personal impairment.

sec15-card-sec15-F14.front: Which two alertness and eyesight problems can alcohol trigger behind the wheel?
sec15-card-sec15-F14.expected_back: Alcohol can cause drowsiness and blurred vision.

sec15-card-sec15-F15.front: What duty applies if someone you know has been drinking asks to drive the vehicle?
sec15-card-sec15-F15.expected_back: Do not let a person known to have been drinking operate the vehicle.

sec15-card-sec15-F16.front: What measurement does blood alcohol concentration describe?
sec15-card-sec15-F16.expected_back: Blood alcohol concentration describes the amount of alcohol in a measured volume of blood.

sec15-card-sec15-F17.front: How can officers estimate a driver's alcohol concentration without drawing blood?
sec15-card-sec15-F17.expected_back: A breath test can be used to estimate alcohol concentration without taking a blood sample.

sec15-card-sec15-F18.front: What BAC threshold does the Louisiana guide state for noncommercial drivers aged twenty-one or older?
sec15-card-sec15-F18.expected_back: For noncommercial drivers age twenty-one or older, the guide states a BAC threshold of zero point zero eight percent.

sec15-card-sec15-F19.front: What lower BAC threshold applies to Louisiana drivers younger than twenty-one?
sec15-card-sec15-F19.expected_back: For drivers younger than twenty-one, the guide states a BAC threshold of zero point zero two percent.

sec15-card-sec15-F20.front: How many alcoholic drinks does it take to begin affecting your ability to operate a vehicle?
sec15-card-sec15-F20.expected_back: Even one alcoholic drink can affect the ability to operate a vehicle.

sec15-card-sec15-F21.front: Which four erratic lane or speed patterns warn that another driver ahead may be impaired?
sec15-card-sec15-F21.expected_back: Weaving, erratic speed, abrupt stopping or unusually slow driving may indicate impairment.

sec15-card-sec15-F22.front: Which two in-vehicle alcohol actions does the Louisiana guide restrict?
sec15-card-sec15-F22.expected_back: The guide describes Louisiana restrictions on both consuming alcohol and possessing an open alcoholic-beverage container in a vehicle.

sec15-card-sec15-F23.front: What two broad consequences follow a DWI conviction under the guide?
sec15-card-sec15-F23.expected_back: A DWI conviction can result in criminal penalties and loss of driving privileges.

sec15-card-sec15-R01.front: How should you position your car around a driver who looks intoxicated instead of intervening?
sec15-card-sec15-R01.expected_back: If another driver appears intoxicated, keep a substantial distance rather than trying to stop that vehicle yourself.

sec15-card-sec15-R02.front: Should you flash lights or motion at a suspected impaired driver to pull over?
sec15-card-sec15-R02.expected_back: Do not signal a suspected impaired driver to pull over.

sec15-card-sec15-R03.front: Under what condition may you jot down a suspected impaired driver's vehicle or plate details?
sec15-card-sec15-R03.expected_back: Record vehicle details or a plate number only if doing so does not compromise safety.

sec15-card-sec15-R04.front: What step must come before dialing emergency services to report a suspected impaired driver?
sec15-card-sec15-R04.expected_back: Pull over before calling emergency services to report a suspected impaired driver’s description and location.

sec15-card-sec15-R05.front: Who holds sole responsibility for stopping and enforcing laws against a suspected impaired motorist?
sec15-card-sec15-R05.expected_back: Leave enforcement action against a suspected impaired motorist to police.

sec15-card-sec15-R06.front: Which three physical or mental effects can medications and other drugs trigger in drivers?
sec15-card-sec15-R06.expected_back: A medicine or other drug can impair coordination or judgment and cause drowsiness.

sec15-card-sec15-R07.front: What happens when someone mixes medications or other drugs with alcohol?
sec15-card-sec15-R07.expected_back: Combining drugs with alcohol can intensify impairment.

sec15-card-sec15-R08.front: Why must you read product warnings on both prescription bottles and over-the-counter boxes?
sec15-card-sec15-R08.memory_hook: Both types affect driving, read warnings
sec15-card-sec15-R08.expected_back: Over-the-counter and prescribed medicines can affect driving, so check the product’s warnings.

sec15-card-sec15-R09.front: How does the guide treat penalties for drug-impaired driving compared with alcohol-impaired driving?
sec15-card-sec15-R09.expected_back: The guide treats drug-impaired driving as subject to impaired-driving penalties as well as alcohol-impaired driving.

sec15-card-sec15-R10.front: Which visual, mental, and perceptual skills can marijuana impair behind the wheel?
sec15-card-sec15-R10.expected_back: Marijuana can affect vision, concentration and judging time, speed or distance.

sec15-card-sec15-R11.front: How does the guide treat criminally negligent or reckless operation of a vehicle?
sec15-card-sec15-R11.expected_back: Criminally negligent or reckless vehicle operation is punishable conduct under the guide.

sec15-card-sec15-R12.front: What three duties bind any driver involved in or causing a crash?
sec15-card-sec15-R12.expected_back: A driver involved in or causing a crash must stop, identify the driver and provide reasonable aid.

sec15-card-sec15-R13.front: What offense can result from knowingly refusing a law-enforcement officer's signal to pull over?
sec15-card-sec15-R13.expected_back: Knowingly refusing an officer’s signal to stop can constitute flight from an officer.

sec15-card-sec15-R14.front: What have drivers automatically consented to by operating a vehicle on Louisiana highways?
sec15-card-sec15-R14.expected_back: Implied consent is the guide’s term for consent to chemical testing associated with operating a vehicle on state highways.

sec15-card-sec15-R15.front: What can happen to your driving privileges if you refuse an alcohol-analysis check?
sec15-card-sec15-R15.expected_back: The guide states that refusing an alcohol-analysis test can result in suspension.

sec15-card-sec15-R16.front: Which three personal and case factors shape chemical-testing consequences?
sec15-card-sec15-R16.expected_back: Chemical-test consequences depend on factors including age, measured alcohol level and previous offenses.

sec15-card-sec15-R17.front: How does a DWI conviction affect your legal driving privileges?
sec15-card-sec15-R17.expected_back: A DWI conviction is listed as a ground for suspending driving privileges.

sec15-card-sec15-R18.front: What licensing penalty can hit a driver who fails to stop for a school bus loading or unloading children?
sec15-card-sec15-R18.expected_back: Failing to stop for a school bus boarding or unloading children is listed as a suspension ground.

sec15-card-sec15-R19.front: What happens if someone misuses a license unlawfully or hides a material fact on an application?
sec15-card-sec15-R19.expected_back: Unlawful license use or concealing an important fact on a license application can result in suspension.

sec15-card-sec15-R20.front: Which two compliance failures with restrictions or court citations can jeopardize driving privileges?
sec15-card-sec15-R20.expected_back: Violating a license restriction or failing to answer a traffic charge can affect driving privileges.

sec15-card-sec15-R21.front: What can happen to your license if you fail to maintain required financial-responsibility coverage?
sec15-card-sec15-R21.expected_back: Failure to meet required financial-responsibility obligations can cause license suspension.

sec15-card-sec15-R22.front: What two consequences hit a motorist caught driving during an active license suspension?
sec15-card-sec15-R22.expected_back: Driving during a suspension can bring further penalties and extend the suspension.

sec15-card-sec15-R23.front: Once a suspension period finishes, what payment is still required before driving privileges return?
sec15-card-sec15-R23.expected_back: After a suspension period ends, the guide requires a reinstatement fee before driving privileges are restored.

sec16-card-sec16-F01.front: What book should you check before hitching up a trailer to verify your car has the right equipment?
sec16-card-sec16-F01.expected_back: Before towing a trailer, consult the vehicle manual to confirm that the vehicle has the necessary equipment.

sec16-card-sec16-F02.front: Which two driving adjustments must account for the heavier combined weight when towing?
sec16-card-sec16-F02.expected_back: Towing changes the combined vehicle weight, so allow for its effect on speed choice and stopping room.

sec16-card-sec16-F03.front: Why must the hitch-ball size match the trailer coupler exactly?
sec16-card-sec16-F03.expected_back: For a ball-and-coupler hitch, the ball size must fit the coupler to prevent the trailer becoming detached.

sec16-card-sec16-F04.front: Beyond holding the ball, what backup anchor point must a trailer hitch provide?
sec16-card-sec16-F04.expected_back: The hitch must provide an attachment point for safety chains or an approved alternative safety device.

sec16-card-sec16-F05.front: How strong must the safety connection between your trailer and tow vehicle be?
sec16-card-sec16-F05.expected_back: Secure the safety connection to the tow vehicle with enough strength to retain the trailer after a hitch separation.

sec16-card-sec16-F06.front: How should you route safety chains under the trailer tongue, and why?
sec16-card-sec16-F06.expected_back: Cross safety chains beneath the trailer tongue so they can help keep it off the roadway if the main connection fails.

sec16-card-sec16-F07.front: How much slack should safety chains carry between turning clearance and ground clearance?
sec16-card-sec16-F07.expected_back: Safety chains need enough looseness for sharp turns but must not scrape along the roadway.

sec16-card-sec16-F08.front: At what gross trailer weight does Louisiana require a trailer to have its own brakes?
sec16-card-sec16-F08.expected_back: The guide requires a trailer with gross weight of three thousand pounds or more to have brakes.

sec16-card-sec16-F09.front: From where must the driver be able to apply required trailer brakes?
sec16-card-sec16-F09.expected_back: The required trailer braking arrangement must allow the towing driver to apply the brakes from the cab.

sec16-card-sec16-F10.front: What must required trailer brakes do automatically if the trailer accidentally separates from your vehicle?
sec16-card-sec16-F10.expected_back: The guide requires the trailer brakes to apply automatically if an accidental separation occurs.

sec16-card-sec16-F11.front: Which four lamp types and two reflector positions make up proper trailer lighting?
sec16-card-sec16-F11.expected_back: Trailer lighting includes rear lamps, brake lamps, turn indicators, side-marker lamps and side and rear reflectors.

sec16-card-sec16-F12.front: What requirement applies to the electrical plugs linking your tow vehicle and trailer?
sec16-card-sec16-F12.expected_back: The tow vehicle and trailer electrical connectors must be compatible.

sec16-card-sec16-F13.front: How should you route the trailer's electrical cable across the hitch gap?
sec16-card-sec16-F13.expected_back: Give the electrical cable enough slack for sharp turns while preventing it from dragging on the ground.

sec16-card-sec16-F14.front: When should you verify that every lamp on your trailer works properly?
sec16-card-sec16-F14.expected_back: Before towing, test that the trailer’s lamps function properly.

sec16-card-sec16-R01.front: Which three tire specifications must match across the wheels on your trailer?
sec16-card-sec16-R01.expected_back: Use trailer tires of matching type, size and construction.

sec16-card-sec16-R02.front: May you run radial trailer tires and bias-belted trailer tires together on the same trailer?
sec16-card-sec16-R02.expected_back: Do not combine radial trailer tires with bias-belted trailer tires.

sec16-card-sec16-R03.front: Which two official sources tell you the right tire size, type, and load range for a trailer?
sec16-card-sec16-R03.expected_back: Select trailer tire size, type and load range from its certification label or owner’s manual.

sec16-card-sec16-R04.front: What does the load rating molded onto a trailer tire tell you?
sec16-card-sec16-R04.expected_back: A tire’s load rating identifies the weight that tire is designed to carry safely.

sec16-card-sec16-R05.front: What two maintenance habits keep trailer tires roadworthy?
sec16-card-sec16-R05.expected_back: Keep trailer tires at the specified pressure and replace tires that are worn.

sec16-card-sec16-R06.front: Can towing—especially a heavy load—require changing tire pressure on the towing vehicle itself?
sec16-card-sec16-R06.expected_back: The towing vehicle may need a different specified tire pressure for towing, especially with a heavy load.

sec16-card-sec16-R07.front: Which vehicles benefit in handling and stability when trailer cargo is positioned properly?
sec16-card-sec16-R07.expected_back: Correct cargo placement improves control of both the tow vehicle and trailer.

sec16-card-sec16-R08.front: Which two load-distribution directions should you set using both your vehicle and trailer manuals?
sec16-card-sec16-R08.expected_back: Use the vehicle and trailer manuals to determine side-to-side load balance and lengthwise cargo distribution.

sec16-card-sec16-R09.front: Why must you brace and tie down cargo inside or atop a trailer?
sec16-card-sec16-R09.expected_back: Secure and brace cargo so it cannot move or fall from the trailer during travel.

sec16-card-sec16-R10.front: What source governs setting your hitch connection height and any weight-distributing bars?
sec16-card-sec16-R10.expected_back: Use the manufacturer’s instructions to set connection height and any weight-distributing hitch equipment.

sec01-card-sec01-F01.front: What credential must a Louisiana resident hold to drive on the state's public streets or highways?
sec01-card-sec01-F01.expected_back: A Louisiana resident who drives on the state’s public streets or highways needs a Louisiana driver license.

sec01-card-sec01-F02.front: When must you have your driver license physically with you?
sec01-card-sec01-F02.expected_back: Keep your driver license with you whenever you drive.

sec01-card-sec01-F03.front: What are you legally required to do when a law-enforcement officer asks to inspect your driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-F03.expected_back: When an officer asks to inspect your driver license, you must show it.

sec01-card-sec01-F04.front: How many days after establishing residency does a newcomer have to get a Louisiana driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-F04.expected_back: A new Louisiana resident has thirty days after establishing residency to obtain a Louisiana license.

sec01-card-sec01-F05.front: How long may a nonresident holding a valid out-of-state license drive in Louisiana without switching?
sec01-card-sec01-F05.expected_back: A nonresident with a valid license from another state may drive in Louisiana for ninety days without obtaining a Louisiana license.

sec01-card-sec01-F06.front: Which two cards exempt a nonresident college student from getting a Louisiana driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-F06.expected_back: A nonresident student is exempt from obtaining a Louisiana license when carrying both a valid home-state license and a current student identification card.

sec01-card-sec01-F07.front: Does temporarily moving a farm tractor, farm implement, or road machine along a highway require a Louisiana license?
sec01-card-sec01-F07.expected_back: Temporarily operating a farm tractor, farm implement or road machinery on a highway does not require obtaining a Louisiana driver license.

sec01-card-sec01-F08.front: When may an Armed Forces member drive a U.S. government vehicle in Louisiana without a state license?
sec01-card-sec01-F08.expected_back: An Armed Forces member operating a United States government vehicle on official duty does not need a Louisiana license for that operation.

sec01-card-sec01-F09.front: What keeps stationed service members and their military dependents exempt from needing a Louisiana license?
sec01-card-sec01-F09.expected_back: Resident service members and their resident military dependents are exempt from obtaining a Louisiana license while holding a valid license from their home state.

sec01-card-sec01-F10.front: Which two factors determine the Louisiana driver-license class you must hold?
sec01-card-sec01-F10.expected_back: The license class you need depends on the vehicle you will operate and whether driving is the main purpose of your employment.

sec01-card-sec01-F11.front: What single-vehicle weight cap and two specialty vehicle types fall under Louisiana's Class E license?
sec01-card-sec01-F11.expected_back: Class E covers a single motor vehicle weighing under ten thousand one pounds, recreational vehicles, and qualifying farm vehicles outside the commercial-vehicle definition.

sec01-card-sec01-F12.front: When is a student authorized to use a Louisiana Temporary Instruction Permit?
sec01-card-sec01-F12.expected_back: A Temporary Instruction Permit is limited to a student’s use while enrolled in driver education or a pre-licensing course.

sec01-card-sec01-F22.front: How many driver licenses does Louisiana law allow one person to hold?
sec01-card-sec01-F22.expected_back: Louisiana does not allow a person to hold more than one driver license.

sec01-card-sec01-F13.front: What form of an applicant's name must appear on a Louisiana license or identification card?
sec01-card-sec01-F13.expected_back: Louisiana licenses and identification cards must use the applicant’s complete legal name.

sec01-card-sec01-F14.front: Which two versions of identity records are accepted at a Louisiana licensing counter?
sec01-card-sec01-F14.expected_back: Identity papers must be originals or copies certified by the department that keeps the record.

sec01-card-sec01-F15.front: Does having a notary public stamp a photocopy make it valid identification at OMV?
sec01-card-sec01-F15.expected_back: A photocopy is not acceptable identification even when a notary has certified it.

sec01-card-sec01-F16.front: What two combinations of primary and secondary documents satisfy Louisiana's first-time applicant list?
sec01-card-sec01-F16.expected_back: The first-time applicant document list permits one primary document with two secondary documents, or two primary documents.

sec01-card-sec01-F17.front: When does holding a Louisiana identification card let you skip bringing extra identity documents?
sec01-card-sec01-F17.expected_back: Additional identification is unnecessary when a Louisiana identification card clearly identifies the applicant by photograph and the file already contains the Social Security number.

sec01-card-sec01-F23.front: What must an applicant who is eligible for a Social Security number include on the license application?
sec01-card-sec01-F23.expected_back: An applicant who qualifies for a Social Security number must include the assigned number in the licensing application.

sec01-card-sec01-F24.front: Where is your Social Security number stored, and does it print on the front of a Louisiana license?
sec01-card-sec01-F24.expected_back: The Social Security number goes into the licensing department’s internal file rather than onto the license face.

sec01-card-sec01-F25.front: What official letter must someone without an assigned Social Security number bring to OMV?
sec01-card-sec01-F25.memory_hook: Official SSA ineligibility or unassigned letter
sec01-card-sec01-F25.expected_back: An applicant without an assigned Social Security number must obtain an official Social Security Administration letter stating that none was assigned or that the applicant is ineligible.

sec01-card-sec01-F26.front: What happens if a male U.S. citizen or immigrant aged fifteen through twenty-six refuses to give his SSN?
sec01-card-sec01-F26.expected_back: The guide requires male United States citizens or immigrants aged fifteen through twenty-six to provide their Social Security number for a license or identification card, and says refusal prevents issuance.

sec01-card-sec01-R13.front: Which birth certificates count as primary documents, and what seal rule applies to a short-form birth card?
sec01-card-sec01-R13.memory_hook: Original, certified; short-form needs no seal
sec01-card-sec01-R13.expected_back: The primary-document birth-record list includes an original birth certificate or a certified birth-certificate copy, and says a short-form birth card does not need a seal.

sec01-card-sec01-R14.front: Which document tier applies to a vital-statistics bureau birth registration from a state or county?
sec01-card-sec01-R14.expected_back: A birth-registration record from a state or county vital-statistics bureau is included among primary identity documents.

sec01-card-sec01-R15.front: Which federal department's certificate of birth abroad qualifies on Louisiana's primary identity list?
sec01-card-sec01-R15.expected_back: The primary identity list includes a State Department certificate documenting a birth abroad.

sec01-card-sec01-R16.front: On which document tier does Louisiana place a Certificate of Naturalization?
sec01-card-sec01-R16.expected_back: A naturalization certificate is included in the primary identity list.

sec01-card-sec01-R17.front: How does the Louisiana guide classify an official Native American tribal document?
sec01-card-sec01-R17.expected_back: A Native American tribal document is included in the primary identity list.

sec01-card-sec01-R18.front: Do both a U.S. passport book and a U.S. passport card qualify as primary documents?
sec01-card-sec01-R18.expected_back: A United States passport book or passport card may serve as a primary document.

sec01-card-sec01-R19.front: What extra parentage or custody proof must an applicant aged seventeen or younger bring alongside a passport?
sec01-card-sec01-R19.expected_back: An applicant seventeen or younger using a passport must also present a certified birth certificate or papers establishing custody or legal guardianship.

sec01-card-sec01-R20.front: What two additions must accompany a foreign passport used as a primary document?
sec01-card-sec01-R20.expected_back: A foreign passport used as a primary document needs the appropriate stamp and accompanying immigration papers.

sec01-card-sec01-R21.front: Which three permanent-resident or Homeland Security travel documents sit on the primary immigration list?
sec01-card-sec01-R21.expected_back: The primary immigration-document list includes a permanent resident card, a Homeland Security refugee travel document or a Homeland Security permit to reenter the United States.

sec01-card-sec01-R22.front: Which six military, draft, separation, or mariner credentials qualify as primary military documents?
sec01-card-sec01-R22.expected_back: The guide’s primary military-document list includes a current United States military identification card, dependent identification, a draft record, separation record, Selective Service notification or Coast Guard Merchant Mariner card.

sec01-card-sec01-R23.front: How must the name on a secondary identification document relate to your primary document?
sec01-card-sec01-R23.expected_back: The name on a secondary identification document should match the name on the primary document.

sec01-card-sec01-R24.front: When does another state's driver license or ID card count as secondary identification in Louisiana?
sec01-card-sec01-R24.expected_back: An out-of-state motor-vehicle agency’s license or identification card may be secondary identification when its photograph clearly identifies the person.

sec01-card-sec01-R25.front: What must you bring if you lost the driver license issued by your previous state?
sec01-card-sec01-R25.expected_back: If an applicant has lost an out-of-state license, the guide requires an official driving record from the last state that issued it.

sec01-card-sec01-R26.front: What paperwork must always accompany a foreign driver license presented at OMV?
sec01-card-sec01-R26.expected_back: A foreign driver license must be accompanied by the appropriate immigration documents.

sec01-card-sec01-R27.front: Which three methods can verify a Social Security number during licensing?
sec01-card-sec01-R27.expected_back: Social Security verification may use the Social Security card, official verification from the Social Security Administration or verbal verification.

sec01-card-sec01-R28.front: Which five school, police, workplace, or agency photo IDs appear on Louisiana's secondary list?
sec01-card-sec01-R28.expected_back: The secondary photo-identification list includes Louisiana school identification, law-enforcement identification, qualifying employer identification and identification from government agencies or Louisiana correctional authorities.

sec01-card-sec01-R29.front: On which document list do a TWIC card and a DHS employment-authorization card appear?
sec01-card-sec01-R29.expected_back: The secondary identification list also includes a Transportation Worker Identification Credential or a Homeland Security employment-authorization document.

sec01-card-sec01-R30.front: What authentication features and day limit govern a Refugee Resettlement Program letter used as secondary ID?
sec01-card-sec01-R30.expected_back: For secondary identification, an original Refugee Resettlement Program letter needs the agency director’s signature and a raised seal, and lasts fifteen days from issuance.

sec01-card-sec01-R31.front: How does Louisiana classify high-school, college, or university diplomas, certificates, and licenses?
sec01-card-sec01-R31.expected_back: High-school, college or university educational diplomas, certificates or licenses appear in the secondary-document list.

sec01-card-sec01-F18.front: Through what age must a custodial parent or legal guardian sign for a minor's license, duplicate, or restriction change?
sec01-card-sec01-F18.expected_back: For an applicant aged seventeen or younger, a custodial parent or legal guardian must sign for license issuance, duplicate issuance and restriction changes.

sec01-card-sec01-F19.front: Whose identification is checked at the counter when a minor applies with a parent or guardian?
sec01-card-sec01-F19.memory_hook: Both minor and parent show ID
sec01-card-sec01-F19.expected_back: Both the minor applicant and the parent or guardian must present identification.

sec01-card-sec01-F20.front: When divorced or separated parents share joint custody, which parent is authorized to sign the minor's application?
sec01-card-sec01-F20.expected_back: When parents have joint custody, only the domiciliary parent may sign the minor’s application.

sec01-card-sec01-F21.front: Beyond IDs and signatures, what court paperwork must accompany a custody-case minor's application?
sec01-card-sec01-F21.expected_back: The minor’s licensing application also requires the custody documents.

sec01-card-sec01-F27.front: What training requirement must every first-license applicant complete and prove before applying?
sec01-card-sec01-F27.expected_back: First-license applicants must finish the required driver education and show proof before applying for the license.

sec01-card-sec01-F28.front: Which three testing or driving milestones require getting a Temporary Instruction Permit beforehand?
sec01-card-sec01-F28.expected_back: A Temporary Instruction Permit must be obtained before a knowledge test, a skills test or any behind-the-wheel instruction.

sec01-card-sec01-F29.front: What minimum age and program path apply to a Class E learner-permit applicant?
sec01-card-sec01-F29.expected_back: A Class E learner-permit applicant must be at least fifteen and complete every applicable graduated-licensing stage.

sec01-card-sec01-R01.front: When a green card dates past July nineteen ninety-seven, which ID tier applies and what pairs with it?
sec01-card-sec01-R01.expected_back: The guide treats a permanent resident card issued after July nineteen ninety-seven as primary identification, together with Social Security verification and a secondary document.

sec01-card-sec01-R02.front: When a green card dates earlier than July nineteen ninety-seven, how does your document checklist shift?
sec01-card-sec01-R02.expected_back: The guide treats a permanent resident card issued before July nineteen ninety-seven as secondary identification, so it also calls for a primary document and Social Security verification.

sec01-card-sec01-R03.front: Which four items make up the foreign-passport substitution when an arrival record was surrendered for permanent residence?
sec01-card-sec01-R03.expected_back: For the listed foreign-passport substitution, the guide requires a stamp showing that the arrival record was surrendered for permanent-resident processing, an employment-authorization card, Social Security verification and a secondary document.

sec01-card-sec01-R04.front: How fresh must the permanent-resident processing stamp be in that foreign-passport substitution?
sec01-card-sec01-R04.expected_back: In that foreign-passport substitution, a stamp less than nine months old permits issuance according to the guide, while a stamp more than nine months old does not.

sec01-card-sec01-R05.front: What pairs with an application to adjust to lawful permanent residence on the guide's ID list?
sec01-card-sec01-R05.expected_back: The guide lists an application to adjust to lawful permanent residence, Social Security verification and a secondary document as another identification combination.

sec01-card-sec01-R06.front: Is the vintage I-one-hundred-fifty-one resident-alien card still valid proof at OMV?
sec01-card-sec01-R06.expected_back: The older resident-alien card designated I-one hundred fifty-one is no longer accepted as proof of identity or status in the guide.

sec01-card-sec01-R07.front: What required and recommended documents apply to a refugee seeking a Louisiana credential?
sec01-card-sec01-R07.expected_back: A refugee must present an arrival record establishing refugee status and two secondary documents, and should also present an available passport with the employment-authorization card.

sec01-card-sec01-R08.front: How long is an original Refugee Resettlement Program letter bearing a color photo accepted?
sec01-card-sec01-R08.expected_back: The guide accepts an original Refugee Resettlement Program letter with a color photograph for fifteen days after issuance.

sec01-card-sec01-R09.front: Which four items appear on the document checklist for a nonimmigrant applicant?
sec01-card-sec01-R09.expected_back: A nonimmigrant applicant’s listed documents are a foreign passport with an arrival record showing immigration status, Social Security verification and a secondary document.

sec01-card-sec01-R10.front: What three school facts must appear on the student document presented by an F-one, J-one, or M-one holder?
sec01-card-sec01-R10.expected_back: A student holding an F-one, J-one or M-one status must present the student document that identifies the school, program duration and school representative contact details.

sec01-card-sec01-R11.front: At least how many days of remaining visa or arrival-record validity are needed to get a Louisiana card?
sec01-card-sec01-R11.expected_back: The guide requires at least thirty days of remaining visa or arrival-record validity before issuing a license or identification card, and denies issuance when less time remains.

sec01-card-sec01-R12.front: Can someone who is not a resident of Louisiana obtain a Louisiana driver license or ID card?
sec01-card-sec01-R12.expected_back: A person who is not a Louisiana resident is not eligible for a Louisiana driver license or identification card.

sec02-card-sec02-F01.front: Which three school-photo, transcript, or report-card options qualify on Louisiana's secondary document list?
sec02-card-sec02-F01.expected_back: The secondary educational-document list includes a yearbook photograph, school records, or at least two report cards from different years.

sec02-card-sec02-F02.front: How do an original or certified professional license, professional degree, or driver-ed certificate rank on the ID list?
sec02-card-sec02-F02.expected_back: An original or certified professional degree or license, or a driver-education certificate, may serve as secondary documentation in the guide.

sec02-card-sec02-F03.front: On which document tier do Medicare, Medicaid, and medical-eligibility cards appear?
sec02-card-sec02-F03.expected_back: The guide lists a Medicare or Medicaid card and a medical-eligibility card among secondary documents.

sec02-card-sec02-F04.front: Which three adoption, church, or Louisiana land-ownership records appear as secondary-document examples?
sec02-card-sec02-F04.expected_back: Secondary-document examples include original adoption papers, a baptismal certificate, and a Louisiana property deed or title, including a burial plot.

sec02-card-sec02-F05.front: Which three car-ownership or loan records qualify as secondary identification?
sec02-card-sec02-F05.expected_back: A vehicle registration, a vehicle title in the applicant’s name, or a motor-vehicle lien document appears in the secondary-document list.

sec02-card-sec02-F06.front: Which two utility documents showing your name and address count on the secondary list?
sec02-card-sec02-F06.expected_back: A utility statement showing the applicant’s name and address, or a receipt showing that utilities were activated, may be secondary documentation.

sec02-card-sec02-F07.front: Which four types of personal insurance policies qualify on Louisiana's secondary-document list?
sec02-card-sec02-F07.expected_back: The guide’s secondary-document list includes health, home, life or automobile insurance policies.

sec02-card-sec02-F08.front: What paycheck document—or how many years of wage-and-tax forms—qualifies as secondary ID?
sec02-card-sec02-F08.expected_back: A printed payroll stub or wage-and-tax forms covering two years are listed as secondary documents.

sec02-card-sec02-F09.front: Which three correctional, probation, or state-placement records appear on the secondary list?
sec02-card-sec02-F09.expected_back: The secondary-document list includes prison-release papers, a probation-officer letter, or verification from a state agency responsible for placing a deprived or impaired person.

sec02-card-sec02-F10.front: Besides identity, lawful status, birth date, and SSN proof, how many home-address documents does a first REAL ID require?
sec02-card-sec02-F10.expected_back: Initial REAL ID issuance requires evidence of identity, lawful United States status, birth date and Social Security number, plus at least two documents showing the principal home address.

sec02-card-sec02-F11.front: Under what condition is a graduated learner-permit holder allowed to drive?
sec02-card-sec02-F11.expected_back: A graduated learner permit limits driving to supervision by a fully licensed driver.

sec02-card-sec02-F12.front: Which two factors does the Louisiana guide link directly to elevated teenage crash risk?
sec02-card-sec02-F12.expected_back: The guide connects the higher crash risk of teenage drivers with limited driving experience and immaturity.

sec02-card-sec02-F13.front: In what exact three-stage order does Louisiana's graduated licensing system progress?
sec02-card-sec02-F13.expected_back: Louisiana graduated licensing proceeds from a supervised learner permit to a restricted intermediate license and then a full license.

sec02-card-sec02-F14.front: What is the minimum age to enter the first stage of Louisiana graduated licensing?
sec02-card-sec02-F14.expected_back: The first graduated-licensing stage requires an applicant to be at least fifteen.

sec02-card-sec02-F15.front: How many classroom hours and behind-the-wheel instruction hours make up the learner-stage course?
sec02-card-sec02-F15.expected_back: The learner stage requires thirty classroom hours and eight hours of behind-the-wheel instruction.

sec02-card-sec02-F16.front: Which two examinations must a learner-stage applicant pass?
sec02-card-sec02-F16.expected_back: The learner-stage applicant must pass the vision and knowledge examinations.

sec02-card-sec02-F17.front: Which two age-and-relationship options qualify someone to supervise a learner-stage driver?
sec02-card-sec02-F17.expected_back: A learner-stage driver must be accompanied by a licensed adult aged at least twenty-one or a sibling aged at least eighteen.

sec02-card-sec02-F18.front: What permit-holding period and birthday milestone are required to step up from learner to intermediate?
sec02-card-sec02-F18.expected_back: Advancement from learner to intermediate requires holding the learner license at least one hundred eighty days and reaching the sixteenth birthday.

sec02-card-sec02-F19.front: How many total and nighttime practice hours must a parent or guardian attest to for a sixteen-year-old's intermediate license?
sec02-card-sec02-F19.expected_back: For a sixteen-year-old’s intermediate upgrade, a parent or legal guardian must attest to at least fifty driving-practice hours with a licensed parent, guardian or adult aged at least twenty-one, including fifteen hours at night.

sec02-card-sec02-F20.front: What prior stage and minimum age are prerequisites for Louisiana's intermediate stage?
sec02-card-sec02-F20.expected_back: The intermediate stage requires completing the learner stage and being at least sixteen.

sec02-card-sec02-F21.front: What minimum percentage score is required on the road-skills exam to earn an intermediate license?
sec02-card-sec02-F21.expected_back: The guide requires a road-skills score of at least eighty percent for intermediate licensing.

sec02-card-sec02-F22.front: Between which overnight hours is an intermediate driver barred from driving solo, and who can accompany them?
sec02-card-sec02-F22.expected_back: An intermediate driver may not drive from eleven p.m. to five a.m. without a licensed adult aged at least twenty-one or a sibling aged at least eighteen.

sec02-card-sec02-F23.front: Between six in the evening and five in the morning, how many non-family passengers under twenty-one may an intermediate driver carry?
sec02-card-sec02-F23.expected_back: From six p.m. to five a.m., an intermediate driver may carry no more than one passenger younger than twenty-one who is outside the immediate family.

sec02-card-sec02-F24.front: Until what birthday must a teen maintain the intermediate license?
sec02-card-sec02-F24.expected_back: The intermediate license must be maintained until the driver turns seventeen.

sec02-card-sec02-F25.front: Which two pathways lead to an unrestricted full Louisiana driver license?
sec02-card-sec02-F25.expected_back: A full license follows successful completion of the learner and intermediate stages, or a first application made at age seventeen or older.

sec02-card-sec02-F26.front: What two course options let an eighteen-or-older newcomer apply for a Class E license or learner permit?
sec02-card-sec02-F26.expected_back: An applicant aged eighteen or older who has not entered graduated licensing may apply for a full Class E license or learner permit after a thirty-eight-hour driver-education course, or a six-hour pre-licensing course plus eight driving-instruction hours.

sec02-card-sec02-F27.front: What financial protection must cover every motor vehicle operated on Louisiana highways?
sec02-card-sec02-F27.expected_back: A vehicle used on Louisiana highways must have liability insurance or another legally allowable substitute.

sec02-card-sec02-F28.front: When OMV issues your driver license, what must you show if you own any vehicles?
sec02-card-sec02-F28.expected_back: At license issuance, an applicant must provide insurance evidence for vehicles the applicant owns.

sec02-card-sec02-F29.front: Which six specific details must appear on acceptable Louisiana proof of auto insurance?
sec02-card-sec02-F29.memory_hook: Insurer, policy, dates, car, insured, NAIC
sec02-card-sec02-F29.expected_back: Acceptable insurance proof identifies the insurer, policy number, coverage dates, vehicle, insured person and insurer’s NAIC number.

sec02-card-sec02-F30.front: Where must your vehicle's insurance card be kept?
sec02-card-sec02-F30.expected_back: The insurance card must remain in the vehicle as evidence of coverage.

sec02-card-sec02-F31.front: Which three screenings or tests can a Louisiana driver-license application involve?
sec02-card-sec02-F31.expected_back: A driver-license application may involve vision screening, a traffic-law knowledge test and an on-road skills test.

sec02-card-sec02-F32.front: During which two credential transactions does OMV screen your eyesight?
sec02-card-sec02-F32.expected_back: Vision is screened when a person applies for or renews a driver license or learner permit.

sec02-card-sec02-F33.front: Does passing the OMV counter vision screening count as a medical eye examination?
sec02-card-sec02-F33.expected_back: The licensing vision screening is not a medical examination.

sec02-card-sec02-F34.front: What minimum visual-acuity standard does the Louisiana guide state for safe driving?
sec02-card-sec02-F34.expected_back: The guide states a minimum vision standard of twenty over forty for safe driving.

sec02-card-sec02-F35.front: What happens if an applicant does not pass OMV's vision screening?
sec02-card-sec02-F35.expected_back: A person who fails the vision screening receives a report for a vision specialist to complete.

sec02-card-sec02-F36.front: If you need glasses or contacts to pass OMV's vision check, what rule attaches to your driving?
sec02-card-sec02-F36.expected_back: When corrective lenses are needed to pass vision screening, the license requires wearing them while driving.

sec02-card-sec02-F37.front: Which numeric restriction code on a Louisiana license signifies corrective lenses?
sec02-card-sec02-F37.expected_back: The corrective-lens restriction is displayed as code one on the license.

sec02-card-sec02-F38.front: How do you get the corrective-lens restriction removed after laser eye surgery?
sec02-card-sec02-F38.expected_back: After laser correction, removing the lens restriction requires visiting OMV and passing screening without glasses or contact lenses.

sec02-card-sec02-F39.front: Which four subject areas appear on every first-time applicant's knowledge exam?
sec02-card-sec02-F39.expected_back: Every first-time applicant must pass a knowledge test covering signs, signals, safe driving and Louisiana driving laws.

sec02-card-sec02-F40.front: What question format does the knowledge test use, and where does every question come from?
sec02-card-sec02-F40.expected_back: The knowledge examination uses multiple-choice questions drawn from the guide’s information.

sec02-card-sec02-F41.front: How is the knowledge examination delivered at most Louisiana offices?
sec02-card-sec02-F41.expected_back: Most offices administer the knowledge examination on a computer.

sec02-card-sec02-F42.front: What percentage of questions must you answer right to pass the knowledge examination?
sec02-card-sec02-F42.expected_back: A correct-answer rate of eighty percent is required to pass the knowledge examination.

sec02-card-sec02-F43.front: What must you bring every single time you sit for the knowledge examination?
sec02-card-sec02-F43.expected_back: Proper identification is required whenever the knowledge examination is taken.

sec02-card-sec02-F44.front: At least how many times does the guide advise reading the manual before taking the written exam?
sec02-card-sec02-F44.expected_back: The guide advises reading the manual at least three times before the written examination.

sec02-card-sec02-F45.front: What test-taking habit does the guide recommend before tapping your answer?
sec02-card-sec02-F45.expected_back: The guide advises reading the whole question and all answer choices before selecting an answer.

sec02-card-sec02-F46.front: How early before an office's final testing cutoff does the guide advise arriving?
sec02-card-sec02-F46.expected_back: The guide recommends arriving at least one hour before the office’s final testing time.

sec02-card-sec02-R01.front: How long does a standard Louisiana driver license run before expiring?
sec02-card-sec02-R01.expected_back: The guide states that a driver license expires six years from the nearest birthday.

sec02-card-sec02-R02.front: How many days ahead of expiration can you request a Louisiana license renewal?
sec02-card-sec02-R02.expected_back: Renewal may be requested during the one hundred eighty days before license expiration.

sec02-card-sec02-R03.front: What screening is required before a driver license can be renewed?
sec02-card-sec02-R03.expected_back: A vision examination is required before a driver license is renewed.

sec02-card-sec02-R04.front: When should you inspect a newly issued license for spelling, address, or restriction typos?
sec02-card-sec02-R04.expected_back: A newly issued license should be checked for correct information before leaving the office.

sec02-card-sec02-R05.front: Why might an immigrant, nonimmigrant, or refugee receive a different license expiration date than six years?
sec02-card-sec02-R05.expected_back: The guide says immigration status may cause a different expiration date for an immigrant, nonimmigrant or refugee.

sec02-card-sec02-R06.front: How long after discharge do valid Louisiana licenses stay good for out-of-state Armed Forces or Peace Corps members and dependents?
sec02-card-sec02-R06.expected_back: For qualifying service outside Louisiana, an Armed Forces or Peace Corps member’s license and qualifying dependents’ licenses remain valid for sixty days after discharge if valid on entering service.

sec02-card-sec02-R07.front: On which exact day after discharge does that military or Peace Corps license turn expired and delinquent?
sec02-card-sec02-R07.expected_back: Under that service rule, the license becomes expired or delinquent on the sixty-first day after discharge.

sec02-card-sec02-R08.front: Which two items renew a license under the military or Peace Corps service-extension rule?
sec02-card-sec02-R08.expected_back: The last license and proof of discharge are accepted for renewal under the service-extension rule.

sec02-card-sec02-R09.front: What age cap and license classes qualify a resident to be selected for mail or internet renewal?
sec02-card-sec02-R09.memory_hook: Under seventy, Class D or E
sec02-card-sec02-R09.expected_back: A Louisiana resident younger than seventy with a Class D or E license may be selected for mail or internet renewal.

sec02-card-sec02-R10.front: Can OMV invite you to renew by mail or internet for two renewals in a row?
sec02-card-sec02-R10.expected_back: Mail or internet renewal invitations are not issued for two consecutive renewal cycles.

sec02-card-sec02-R11.front: If OMV sends you a mail or online renewal invitation, are you forced to renew remotely?
sec02-card-sec02-R11.expected_back: A driver who is offered mail or internet renewal may instead renew in person.

sec02-card-sec02-R12.front: Within how many days after moving must you update the address on your Louisiana license?
sec02-card-sec02-R12.expected_back: A driver must update the address on a Louisiana license within ten days after moving.

sec02-card-sec02-R13.front: Which three certified records can authorize changing the legal name on your Louisiana license?
sec02-card-sec02-R13.expected_back: A license name change may be supported by a certified marriage license, a certified birth certificate for return to the birth name, or a certified court order authorizing the change.

sec02-card-sec02-R14.front: What fee applies when you change the name on your license mid-cycle between renewals?
sec02-card-sec02-R14.expected_back: A name change between renewals incurs a duplicate-license fee.

sec02-card-sec02-R15.front: Where do you apply to replace a lost, stolen, or destroyed Louisiana driver license?
sec02-card-sec02-R15.expected_back: A lost, stolen or destroyed license may be replaced by applying in person at a motor-vehicle office.

sec02-card-sec02-R16.front: Who must appear with ID and custody papers to sign for a minor's duplicate license—especially in joint custody?
sec02-card-sec02-R16.expected_back: For a minor’s duplicate license, a custodial or domiciliary parent, tutor or legal guardian must appear with identification and custody documents to sign; with joint custody, only the domiciliary parent may sign.

sec02-card-sec02-R17.front: What vehicle-coverage proof is required when applying for a duplicate license?
sec02-card-sec02-R17.expected_back: A duplicate-license applicant must provide current liability-insurance proof for any registered vehicle.

sec02-card-sec02-R18.front: Which two authorities can place driving restrictions onto your Louisiana license?
sec02-card-sec02-R18.expected_back: OMV or a court may impose driving restrictions that appear on the license.

sec02-card-sec02-R19.front: What legal consequence can follow driving in violation of a restriction printed on your license?
sec02-card-sec02-R19.expected_back: Violating a license restriction breaks the law and can cause suspension of driving privileges.

sec02-card-sec02-R20.front: Which two groups of first-time license applicants must bring a detailed physician or vision-specialist report?
sec02-card-sec02-R20.expected_back: The guide requires a detailed physician or vision-specialist report for a physically impaired first-time applicant or a first-time applicant older than sixty.

sec02-card-sec02-R21.front: Where do you get the required medical-report form, and what must the doctor describe on it?
sec02-card-sec02-R21.expected_back: The required medical-report form must be obtained from OMV and must describe conditions that could impair safe driving.

sec02-card-sec02-R22.front: What reports or exams may OMV require of any driver when safety questions arise?
sec02-card-sec02-R22.expected_back: OMV may require anyone to provide a medical or vision report and may also require written or road-skills testing.

sec02-card-sec02-R23.front: How long do ordinary traffic convictions and crashes stay on public OMV records versus DWI convictions?
sec02-card-sec02-R23.expected_back: OMV keeps public records of traffic convictions and collisions for five years, while DWI convictions remain for ten years, including convictions received in other states.

sec02-card-sec02-R24.front: What does a Louisiana identification card prove, and does it let you drive?
sec02-card-sec02-R24.expected_back: A Louisiana identification card proves identity but does not authorize driving.

sec02-card-sec02-R25.front: Which two core requirements apply to anyone seeking a Louisiana identification card?
sec02-card-sec02-R25.expected_back: An identification-card applicant must meet the identification requirements and have a valid Louisiana residential address.

sec02-card-sec02-R26.front: Which four revocation, training, testing, or age conditions make someone ineligible for a Louisiana license?
sec02-card-sec02-R26.expected_back: The guide lists a revoked license, unfinished required driver training, unpassed required tests and age below fifteen as reasons a person is ineligible for a driver license.

sec02-card-sec02-R27.front: What happens to your driving privileges if you alter a license, misuse it, or lie on an application?
sec02-card-sec02-R27.expected_back: Altering license information, using a license unlawfully, or falsifying or hiding a material application fact can result in losing driving privileges.

sec02-card-sec02-R28.front: What happens to your license if you fail to stop and help after an injury or fatal crash?
sec02-card-sec02-R28.expected_back: Failing to stop and assist after a collision involving injury or death can result in loss of driving privileges.

sec02-card-sec02-R29.front: How do either a DWI conviction or refusing chemical alcohol testing after a DWI arrest affect your license?
sec02-card-sec02-R29.expected_back: A DWI conviction or refusal of an alcohol-analysis test after a DWI arrest can result in losing driving privileges.

sec02-card-sec02-R30.front: What blood-alcohol percentages trigger license loss for drivers twenty-one-plus versus drivers under twenty-one?
sec02-card-sec02-R30.memory_hook: Point zero eight adult; zero-two underage
sec02-card-sec02-R30.expected_back: The guide lists an alcohol-test result of at least zero point zero eight percent for a driver twenty-one or older, or at least zero point zero two percent for a driver younger than twenty-one, as grounds for losing driving privileges.

sec02-card-sec02-R31.front: What license penalty can hit a driver who fails to stop for a school bus loading or unloading kids?
sec02-card-sec02-R31.expected_back: Failing to stop for a school bus while children are loading or unloading can result in loss of driving privileges.

sec02-card-sec02-R32.front: How do vehicle manslaughter, negligent homicide, or any felony committed using a vehicle affect your license?
sec02-card-sec02-R32.expected_back: Vehicle-related manslaughter, negligent homicide or another felony committed while operating a vehicle can result in loss of driving privileges.

sec02-card-sec02-R33.front: How many reckless-driving convictions inside twelve months can strip your driving privileges?
sec02-card-sec02-R33.expected_back: Three reckless-driving convictions within twelve months can result in losing driving privileges.

sec02-card-sec02-R34.front: Which four court-appearance, restriction, insurance, or suspension violations can cost driving privileges?
sec02-card-sec02-R34.expected_back: Unanswered traffic charges, violation of a license restriction, failure to meet financial-responsibility requirements or driving while suspended can result in loss of driving privileges.

sec02-card-sec02-R35.front: When does a traffic violation committed in another state jeopardize your Louisiana license?
sec02-card-sec02-R35.expected_back: An out-of-state offense can affect Louisiana driving privileges when the same offense would support suspension or revocation in Louisiana.

sec02-card-sec02-R36.front: Which two unpaid family or state-revenue obligations can cost your Louisiana driving privileges?
sec02-card-sec02-R36.expected_back: The guide lists unpaid child support or state income taxes as possible grounds for losing driving privileges.

sec02-card-sec02-R37.front: What school-enrollment or truancy issues can affect driving privileges for fifteen- through seventeen-year-olds?
sec02-card-sec02-R37.expected_back: Leaving school before graduation while aged fifteen through seventeen, or being found habitually absent or tardy, can affect driving privileges.

sec02-card-sec02-R38.front: Does waste have to be thrown out on purpose to count as littering in Louisiana?
sec02-card-sec02-R38.expected_back: Littering includes improperly leaving or discarding waste whether intentionally or unintentionally.

sec02-card-sec02-R39.front: Which three categories of littering does the Louisiana guide distinguish?
sec02-card-sec02-R39.expected_back: The guide distinguishes accidental simple littering, deliberate intentional littering and gross littering involving large amounts of waste or an illegal dump.

sec02-card-sec02-R40.front: What four roadway consequences can result when unsecured loads shed debris onto traffic?
sec02-card-sec02-R40.expected_back: Unsecured loads can shed objects that cause collisions, delays, injuries or deaths.

sec02-card-sec02-R41.front: How many pieces of roadside litter did the cited two thousand twenty-three Keep Louisiana Beautiful study find?
sec02-card-sec02-R41.expected_back: The guide attributes more than one hundred forty-three point eight million Louisiana roadside litter pieces to a two thousand twenty-three Keep Louisiana Beautiful study.

sec02-card-sec02-R42.front: What share of Louisiana roadside litter comes from motorists, pickups, garbage trucks, and unsecured loads?
sec02-card-sec02-R42.expected_back: The guide attributes more than seventy-nine percent of Louisiana roadside litter to motorists, pickup trucks, garbage trucks and unsecured loads.

sec02-card-sec02-R43.front: Which item topped the study as the most littered small item, and which was the most visible roadside item?
sec02-card-sec02-R43.memory_hook: Cigarette butts smallest; bottles most visible
sec02-card-sec02-R43.expected_back: Cigarette butts are identified as the most littered small item and plastic water bottles as the most visible littered roadside item in the guide’s cited study.

sec02-card-sec02-R44.front: How many roadside plastic items did the study count, and at what share of surveyed sites did water bottles appear?
sec02-card-sec02-R44.expected_back: The cited study found more than sixty-one point nine million roadside plastic items, with plastic water bottles present at eighty percent of surveyed sites.

sec02-card-sec02-R45.front: How does roadside trash reach bayous and rivers, and what percentage of land litter ends up in waterways?
sec02-card-sec02-R45.expected_back: The guide states that wind and rain move light roadside waste into waterways and that eighty percent of land litter eventually reaches a waterway.

sec02-card-sec02-R46.front: What three environmental harms do discarded cigarette butts cause across water, wildlife, and land?
sec02-card-sec02-R46.expected_back: The guide explains that cigarette litter releases pollutants in water, may be eaten by wildlife, and has caused wildfires on land.

sec02-card-sec02-R47.front: What types of court proceedings can follow either accidental or deliberate littering?
sec02-card-sec02-R47.expected_back: Accidental and deliberate littering are both unlawful and can lead to civil or criminal proceedings.

sec02-card-sec02-R48.front: Compare first-offense and second-offense penalties—in dollars or community-service hours—for simple littering?
sec02-card-sec02-R48.memory_hook: One-fifty or eight; nine-hundred or twenty
sec02-card-sec02-R48.expected_back: For simple littering, the guide lists a first-offense penalty of a one hundred fifty-dollar fine or eight community-service hours, rising for a second offense to nine hundred dollars or twenty community-service hours.

sec02-card-sec02-R49.front: Who is held legally responsible if a passenger tosses litter out the window or trash blows from the truck bed?
sec02-card-sec02-R49.expected_back: A driver is responsible for litter leaving the vehicle or truck bed, including litter discarded by passengers.

sec02-card-sec02-R50.front: What must you do with a loaded pickup truck bed before driving?
sec02-card-sec02-R50.expected_back: A loaded truck bed must be covered or secured so cargo and debris do not fall out.

sec02-card-sec02-R51.front: Which five details belong in a litter report, and what safety rule governs making the call?
sec02-card-sec02-R51.expected_back: A litter report should record the vehicle description and plate, plus the incident’s date, time and location, and the call should be made while parked.

sec02-card-sec02-R52.front: How much does Louisiana spend every year cleaning up and preventing litter?
sec02-card-sec02-R52.expected_back: The guide reports ninety-one point four million dollars in annual Louisiana litter cleanup and prevention spending.

sec02-card-sec02-R53.front: Which six economic, drainage, wildlife, and community problems does the guide trace to litter?
sec02-card-sec02-R53.memory_hook: Values, tourism, clogged drains, flooding, wildlife
sec02-card-sec02-R53.expected_back: The guide links litter with reduced property values, weaker business and tourism activity, blocked drainage, flooding risk, harm to wildlife and reduced quality of life.

sec02-card-sec02-R54.front: What three cabin, passenger, and truck-bed habits stop vehicle litter at the source?
sec02-card-sec02-R54.memory_hook: Bag trash, curb passengers, secure beds
sec02-card-sec02-R54.expected_back: Prevent litter by containing vehicle trash until it can be placed in a receptacle, requiring passengers not to litter, and keeping loose items from escaping a truck bed.

sec02-card-sec02-R55.front: What simple item should a smoker keep in the vehicle instead of flicking butts out a window?
sec02-card-sec02-R55.expected_back: A smoker can keep a portable ashtray in the vehicle rather than discard cigarette butts through a window.

sec08-card-sec08-F01.front: Where should you aim your gaze while driving instead of staring right off your front bumper?
sec08-card-sec08-F01.expected_back: Look well ahead rather than focusing only on the area immediately in front of the vehicle.

sec08-card-sec08-F02.front: How many seconds ahead along your intended path does Louisiana's guide recommend scanning?
sec08-card-sec08-F02.expected_back: The guide recommends a visual lead of twenty to thirty seconds along the intended travel path.

sec08-card-sec08-F03.front: What two adjustments should you make whenever a hill, curve, or tall truck blocks your forward view?
sec08-card-sec08-F03.expected_back: If a curve, hill or vehicle blocks the view ahead, reduce speed and prepare to adjust the travel path.

sec08-card-sec08-F04.front: Which three forward vehicle movements should your distant scan actively watch for?
sec08-card-sec08-F04.expected_back: Watch for vehicles entering the roadway, moving into the lane or turning ahead.

sec08-card-sec08-F05.front: What early traffic clue do illuminated brake lights several cars ahead give you?
sec08-card-sec08-F05.expected_back: Brake lights ahead give advance warning that other traffic is slowing.

sec08-card-sec08-F06.front: How should you approach a green traffic light that has already been shining for a long while?
sec08-card-sec08-F06.expected_back: A green signal that has been showing for a long time may change before the vehicle reaches it; prepare for a stop.

sec08-card-sec08-F07.front: How do early, gradual speed or lane adjustments help motorists trailing behind you?
sec08-card-sec08-F07.expected_back: Early, gradual changes give drivers behind more time to respond.
