sec15-card-sec15-R02.teaching_text: Startling or confronting an impaired stranger on the road risks panic swerves or roadside hostility.

sec15-card-sec15-R03.question_text: Under what condition may you jot down a suspected impaired driver's vehicle or plate details?
sec15-card-sec15-R03.teaching_text: Chasing a weaving car or typing while moving turns you into a second hazard on the highway.

sec15-card-sec15-R04.question_text: What step must come before dialing emergency services to report a suspected impaired driver?
sec15-card-sec15-R04.teaching_text: Stopping clear of lanes lets you relay vehicle description and milepost calmly without distracted driving.

sec15-card-sec15-R05.question_text: Who holds sole responsibility for stopping and enforcing laws against a suspected impaired motorist?
sec15-card-sec15-R05.teaching_text: Trained officers have emergency lights, radios, and tactics to intercept impaired vehicles safely.

sec15-card-sec15-R06.question_text: Which three physical or mental effects can medications and other drugs trigger in drivers?
sec15-card-sec15-R06.teaching_text: Clumsy steering, dulled choices, and heavy eyelids make drug-affected driving just as hazardous as drinking.

sec15-card-sec15-R07.question_text: What happens when someone mixes medications or other drugs with alcohol?
sec15-card-sec15-R07.teaching_text: Combined chemicals amplify sedation and reaction loss far beyond what either dose causes alone.

sec15-card-sec15-R08.question_text: Why must you read product warnings on both prescription bottles and over-the-counter boxes?
sec15-card-sec15-R08.teaching_text: Everyday allergy tablets and prescribed pain relievers alike carry hidden drowsiness warnings.
sec15-card-sec15-R08.must_match_memory_hook: Both types affect driving, read warnings

visual_sync.text_span: Both types affect driving, read warnings

sec15-card-sec15-R09.question_text: How does the guide treat penalties for drug-impaired driving compared with alcohol-impaired driving?
sec15-card-sec15-R09.teaching_text: Passing an alcohol breath check offers zero immunity when drugs impair your driving.

sec15-card-sec15-R10.question_text: Which visual, mental, and perceptual skills can marijuana impair behind the wheel?
sec15-card-sec15-R10.teaching_text: Warped time and distance tracking causes late braking and misjudged intersection gaps.

sec15-card-sec15-R11.question_text: How does the guide treat criminally negligent or reckless operation of a vehicle?
sec15-card-sec15-R11.teaching_text: Gross disregard for road safety brings severe penalties even when zero alcohol is involved.

sec15-card-sec15-R12.question_text: What three duties bind any driver involved in or causing a crash?
sec15-card-sec15-R12.teaching_text: Staying on scene with ID and helping injured victims fulfills both moral and statutory law.

sec15-card-sec15-R13.question_text: What offense can result from knowingly refusing a law-enforcement officer's signal to pull over?
sec15-card-sec15-R13.teaching_text: Keeping going when strobes light behind you escalates a traffic stop into criminal flight.

sec15-card-sec15-R14.question_text: What have drivers automatically consented to by operating a vehicle on Louisiana highways?
sec15-card-sec15-R14.teaching_text: Using public state roads carries a built-in agreement to lawful impairment testing when stopped.

sec15-card-sec15-R15.question_text: What can happen to your driving privileges if you refuse an alcohol-analysis check?
sec15-card-sec15-R15.teaching_text: Saying no to chemical analysis still costs your license privilege on the spot under implied-consent rules.

sec15-card-sec15-R16.question_text: Which three personal and case factors shape chemical-testing consequences?
sec15-card-sec15-R16.teaching_text: Underage status, high blood readings, or repeat offenses each steepen suspension penalties.

sec15-card-sec15-R17.question_text: How does a DWI conviction affect your legal driving privileges?
sec15-card-sec15-R17.teaching_text: Both courts and state licensing authorities pull your driving privileges following an impaired-driving conviction.

sec15-card-sec15-R18.question_text: What licensing penalty can hit a driver who fails to stop for a school bus loading or unloading children?
sec15-card-sec15-R18.teaching_text: Blowing past a boarding school bus endangers children and ranks serious enough to suspend your driver's license.

sec15-card-sec15-R19.question_text: What happens if someone misuses a license unlawfully or hides a material fact on an application?
sec15-card-sec15-R19.teaching_text: Lending a card, altering ID, or lying on paperwork invalidates your privilege to hold a license.

sec15-card-sec15-R20.question_text: Which two compliance failures with restrictions or court citations can jeopardize driving privileges?
sec15-card-sec15-R20.teaching_text: Skipping corrective lenses or ignoring a traffic summons puts your active license status at risk.

sec15-card-sec15-R21.question_text: What can happen to your license if you fail to maintain required financial-responsibility coverage?
sec15-card-sec15-R21.teaching_text: Letting mandatory liability obligations lapse grounds your driving privilege until compliance returns.

sec15-card-sec15-R22.question_text: What two consequences hit a motorist caught driving during an active license suspension?
sec15-card-sec15-R22.teaching_text: Getting caught behind the wheel before reinstatement stacks fresh fines and stretches your time off the road.

sec15-card-sec15-R23.question_text: Once a suspension period finishes, what payment is still required before driving privileges return?
sec15-card-sec15-R23.teaching_text: Calendar expiration alone never restores your license until the reinstatement fee clears your record.

sec16-card-sec16-F01.question_text: What book should you check before hitching up a trailer to verify your car has the right equipment?
sec16-card-sec16-F01.teaching_text: Your owner's manual spells out transmission coolers, wiring harnesses, and factory towing limits before anything breaks.

sec16-card-sec16-F02.question_text: Which two driving adjustments must account for the heavier combined weight when towing?
sec16-card-sec16-F02.teaching_text: Pulling extra tonnage pushes your car forward under braking, demanding lower speeds and longer cushions ahead.

sec16-card-sec16-F03.question_text: Why must the hitch-ball size match the trailer coupler exactly?
sec16-card-sec16-F03.teaching_text: Latching a two-inch coupler onto a slightly smaller ball looks fine parked until the first bump pops it loose.

sec16-card-sec16-F04.question_text: Beyond holding the ball, what backup anchor point must a trailer hitch provide?
sec16-card-sec16-F04.teaching_text: Every legal hitch includes dedicated loops for safety chains or an approved backup retention device.

sec16-card-sec16-F05.question_text: How strong must the safety connection between your trailer and tow vehicle be?
sec16-card-sec16-F05.teaching_text: Flimsy hardware snaps on impact; your backup connection must hold the full loaded trailer if the coupler lets go.

sec16-card-sec16-F06.question_text: How should you route safety chains under the trailer tongue, and why?
sec16-card-sec16-F06.teaching_text: Criss-crossing chains forms a metal cradle that catches a dropped tongue before it digs into highway asphalt.

sec16-card-sec16-F07.question_text: How much slack should safety chains carry between turning clearance and ground clearance?
sec16-card-sec16-F07.teaching_text: Chains pulled too tight bind on sharp corners, while chains drooping onto pavement grind links thin and spark.

sec16-card-sec16-F08.question_text: At what gross trailer weight does Louisiana require a trailer to have its own brakes?
sec16-card-sec16-F08.teaching_text: Once a loaded trailer hits three thousand pounds gross weight, your tow car's brakes alone are not legal.

sec16-card-sec16-F09.question_text: From where must the driver be able to apply required trailer brakes?
sec16-card-sec16-F09.teaching_text: Cab-accessible brake control lets the driver tame trailer sway or add braking smoothly from the driver's seat.

sec16-card-sec16-F10.question_text: What must required trailer brakes do automatically if the trailer accidentally separates from your vehicle?
sec16-card-sec16-F10.teaching_text: A breakaway switch triggers trailer brakes automatically on separation so a runaway rig halts instead of rolling into oncoming lanes.

sec16-card-sec16-F11.question_text: Which four lamp types and two reflector positions make up proper trailer lighting?
sec16-card-sec16-F11.teaching_text: Other drivers rely on rear, brake, blinker, and side-marker lamps plus side and rear reflectors to judge trailer length.

sec16-card-sec16-F12.question_text: What requirement applies to the electrical plugs linking your tow vehicle and trailer?
sec16-card-sec16-F12.teaching_text: Incompatible four-pin and seven-blade plugs need a proper adapter rather than loose taped wires that drop signals.

sec16-card-sec16-F13.question_text: How should you route the trailer's electrical cable across the hitch gap?
sec16-card-sec16-F13.teaching_text: Just like safety chains, wiring needs enough loop for tight turns without rubbing raw against asphalt.

sec16-card-sec16-F14.question_text: When should you verify that every lamp on your trailer works properly?
sec16-card-sec16-F14.teaching_text: Walking behind the trailer to check running, brake, and turn bulbs before leaving avoids rear-end surprises.

sec16-card-sec16-R01.question_text: Which three tire specifications must match across the wheels on your trailer?
sec16-card-sec16-R01.teaching_text: Mixing mismatched tire sizes or builds makes one side flex and heat unevenly at highway speeds.

sec16-card-sec16-R02.question_text: May you run radial trailer tires and bias-belted trailer tires together on the same trailer?
sec16-card-sec16-R02.teaching_text: Radials and bias-belted plies flex completely differently under load, triggering dangerous trailer wander and sway.

sec16-card-sec16-R03.question_text: Which two official sources tell you the right tire size, type, and load range for a trailer?
sec16-card-sec16-R03.teaching_text: Guessing from old mounted tires can copy a prior owner's mistake; read the certification plate or manual.

sec16-card-sec16-R04.question_text: What does the load rating molded onto a trailer tire tell you?
sec16-card-sec16-R04.teaching_text: Exceeding a tire's load rating overheats sidewalls and sets up high-speed trailer blowouts.

sec16-card-sec16-R05.question_text: What two maintenance habits keep trailer tires roadworthy?
sec16-card-sec16-R05.teaching_text: Sitting parked for months bleeds air and ages rubber, so inflate to spec and swap worn treads.

sec16-card-sec16-R06.question_text: Can towing—especially a heavy load—require changing tire pressure on the towing vehicle itself?
sec16-card-sec16-R06.teaching_text: Tongue weight presses down on your rear car axle, so check whether your car specifies higher towing PSI.

sec16-card-sec16-R07.question_text: Which vehicles benefit in handling and stability when trailer cargo is positioned properly?
sec16-card-sec16-R07.teaching_text: Badly placed cargo pushes and pulls through the hitch ball, unsettling both your steering axle and the trailer.

sec16-card-sec16-R08.question_text: Which two load-distribution directions should you set using both your vehicle and trailer manuals?
sec16-card-sec16-R08.teaching_text: Lopsided weight left-to-right overloads one wheel bearing while bad lengthwise balance hurts tongue weight.

sec16-card-sec16-R09.question_text: Why must you brace and tie down cargo inside or atop a trailer?
sec16-card-sec16-R09.teaching_text: Even cargo inside an enclosed box trailer can slam rearward on hills and trigger sudden sway unless braced.

sec16-card-sec16-R10.question_text: What source governs setting your hitch connection height and any weight-distributing bars?
sec16-card-sec16-R10.teaching_text: Improperly tensioned weight-distributing bars or nose-high hitches unload front steering tires unless set per maker specs.

sec01-card-sec01-F01.question_text: What credential must a Louisiana resident hold to drive on the state's public streets or highways?
sec01-card-sec01-F01.teaching_text: Driving public parish or state roads as a resident without a Louisiana license leaves you unlicensed at stops.

sec01-card-sec01-F02.question_text: When must you have your driver license physically with you?
sec01-card-sec01-F02.teaching_text: Even a quick two-minute run to the corner store requires having your license along.

sec01-card-sec01-F03.question_text: What are you legally required to do when a law-enforcement officer asks to inspect your driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-F03.teaching_text: Refusing to hand over or display your license during a lawful stop turns a routine check into a violation.

sec01-card-sec01-F04.question_text: How many days after establishing residency does a newcomer have to get a Louisiana driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-F04.teaching_text: Once you establish a Louisiana home, your old out-of-state card covers only the first thirty days.

sec01-card-sec01-F05.question_text: How long may a nonresident holding a valid out-of-state license drive in Louisiana without switching?
sec01-card-sec01-F05.teaching_text: Notice nonresidents get ninety visiting days, triple the thirty-day deadline for someone who moves in permanently.

sec01-card-sec01-F06.question_text: Which two cards exempt a nonresident college student from getting a Louisiana driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-F06.teaching_text: Leaving your current campus ID in the dorm removes half the pair proving your nonresident student exemption.

sec01-card-sec01-F07.question_text: Does temporarily moving a farm tractor, farm implement, or road machine along a highway require a Louisiana license?
sec01-card-sec01-F07.teaching_text: Short highway transfers of tractors or road-work machinery do not trigger standard driver-licensing rules.

sec01-card-sec01-F08.question_text: When may an Armed Forces member drive a U.S. government vehicle in Louisiana without a state license?
sec01-card-sec01-F08.teaching_text: Operating a federal military rig on official orders is exempt, unlike personal off-duty driving.

sec01-card-sec01-F09.question_text: What keeps stationed service members and their military dependents exempt from needing a Louisiana license?
sec01-card-sec01-F09.teaching_text: Military families stationed in Louisiana stay legal as long as their home-state licenses remain unexpired.

sec01-card-sec01-F10.question_text: Which two factors determine the Louisiana driver-license class you must hold?
sec01-card-sec01-F10.teaching_text: Even a midsize van can bump you above personal Class E if driving is your main paid job.

sec01-card-sec01-F11.question_text: What single-vehicle weight cap and two specialty vehicle types fall under Louisiana's Class E license?
sec01-card-sec01-F11.teaching_text: Louisiana's everyday personal license is Class E—not Class D—capping single cars below ten thousand one pounds.

sec01-card-sec01-F12.question_text: When is a student authorized to use a Louisiana Temporary Instruction Permit?
sec01-card-sec01-F12.teaching_text: A Temporary Instruction Permit covers enrolled course training, not solo errands or post-course family road trips.

sec01-card-sec01-F22.question_text: How many driver licenses does Louisiana law allow one person to hold?
sec01-card-sec01-F22.teaching_text: Holding two active driver licenses across states or classes violates Louisiana's single-license rule.

sec01-card-sec01-F13.question_text: What form of an applicant's name must appear on a Louisiana license or identification card?
sec01-card-sec01-F13.teaching_text: Everyday nicknames or initials get rejected at OMV counters because credentials require your full legal name.

sec01-card-sec01-F14.question_text: Which two versions of identity records are accepted at a Louisiana licensing counter?
sec01-card-sec01-F14.teaching_text: Only the government office that keeps the official record can issue an acceptable certified copy.

sec01-card-sec01-F15.question_text: Does having a notary public stamp a photocopy make it valid identification at OMV?
sec01-card-sec01-F15.teaching_text: Test makers love the notarized-copy distractor, yet OMV rejects every photocopy regardless of notary stamps.

sec01-card-sec01-F16.question_text: What two combinations of primary and secondary documents satisfy Louisiana's first-time applicant list?
sec01-card-sec01-F16.teaching_text: Bringing two primary documents lets you skip secondary papers altogether, or pair one primary with two secondaries.

sec01-card-sec01-F17.question_text: When does holding a Louisiana identification card let you skip bringing extra identity documents?
sec01-card-sec01-F17.teaching_text: An existing state ID with a clear photo and your Social Security number already on file satisfies identity.

sec01-card-sec01-F23.question_text: What must an applicant who is eligible for a Social Security number include on the license application?
sec01-card-sec01-F23.teaching_text: Leaving the Social Security field blank when you qualify for a number stalls your Louisiana application.

sec01-card-sec01-F24.question_text: Where is your Social Security number stored, and does it print on the front of a Louisiana license?
sec01-card-sec01-F24.teaching_text: Keeping your number inside OMV's confidential file protects you from identity theft if you lose your wallet.

sec01-card-sec01-F25.question_text: What official letter must someone without an assigned Social Security number bring to OMV?
sec01-card-sec01-F25.teaching_text: Applicants ineligible for a number bring formal Social Security Administration proof confirming none was assigned.
sec01-card-sec01-F25.must_match_memory_hook: Official SSA ineligibility or unassigned letter

visual_sync.text_span: Official SSA ineligibility or unassigned letter

sec01-card-sec01-F26.question_text: What happens if a male U.S. citizen or immigrant aged fifteen through twenty-six refuses to give his SSN?
sec01-card-sec01-F26.teaching_text: Males from fifteen through twenty-six must supply their Social Security number or walk out without a credential.

sec01-card-sec01-R13.question_text: Which birth certificates count as primary documents, and what seal rule applies to a short-form birth card?
sec01-card-sec01-R13.teaching_text: While paper copies need vital-records certification, an official wallet-style short-form birth card needs no raised seal.
sec01-card-sec01-R13.must_match_memory_hook: Original, certified; short-form needs no seal

visual_sync.text_span: Original, certified; short-form needs no seal

sec01-card-sec01-R14.question_text: Which document tier applies to a vital-statistics bureau birth registration from a state or county?
sec01-card-sec01-R14.teaching_text: Official state or county vital-statistics registrations carry full primary-document weight just like birth certificates.

sec01-card-sec01-R15.question_text: Which federal department's certificate of birth abroad qualifies on Louisiana's primary identity list?
sec01-card-sec01-R15.teaching_text: Americans born overseas prove primary identity with their official U.S. Department of State birth certificate.

sec01-card-sec01-R16.question_text: On which document tier does Louisiana place a Certificate of Naturalization?
sec01-card-sec01-R16.teaching_text: Naturalized citizens use their federal naturalization certificate directly as a primary identity document.

sec01-card-sec01-R17.question_text: How does the Louisiana guide classify an official Native American tribal document?
sec01-card-sec01-R17.teaching_text: Recognized Native American tribal documents stand on the primary identity list alongside passports and birth records.

sec01-card-sec01-R18.question_text: Do both a U.S. passport book and a U.S. passport card qualify as primary documents?
sec01-card-sec01-R18.teaching_text: Either the traditional passport booklet or the wallet-sized U.S. passport card satisfies primary identity.

sec01-card-sec01-R19.question_text: What extra parentage or custody proof must an applicant aged seventeen or younger bring alongside a passport?
sec01-card-sec01-R19.teaching_text: Because a U.S. passport does not list parents' names, minors seventeen and under must add birth or custody papers.

sec01-card-sec01-R20.question_text: What two additions must accompany a foreign passport used as a primary document?
sec01-card-sec01-R20.teaching_text: An unstamped foreign passport alone falls short without its matching federal entry stamp and immigration records.

sec01-card-sec01-R21.question_text: Which three permanent-resident or Homeland Security travel documents sit on the primary immigration list?
sec01-card-sec01-R21.teaching_text: Permanent resident cards plus DHS refugee travel documents and reentry permits all hold primary status.

sec01-card-sec01-R22.question_text: Which six military, draft, separation, or mariner credentials qualify as primary military documents?
sec01-card-sec01-R22.teaching_text: Active IDs, dependent cards, draft or separation records, Selective Service notices, and Merchant Mariner cards count primary.

sec01-card-sec01-R23.question_text: How must the name on a secondary identification document relate to your primary document?
sec01-card-sec01-R23.teaching_text: Bringing secondary records under an unlinked maiden or former name triggers mismatch delays unless documented.

sec01-card-sec01-R24.question_text: When does another state's driver license or ID card count as secondary identification in Louisiana?
sec01-card-sec01-R24.teaching_text: A worn or faded out-of-state card fails unless the photograph still clearly identifies you.

sec01-card-sec01-R25.question_text: What must you bring if you lost the driver license issued by your previous state?
sec01-card-sec01-R25.teaching_text: When you cannot hand over the physical plastic card, OMV requires an official driving abstract from that last state.

sec01-card-sec01-R26.question_text: What paperwork must always accompany a foreign driver license presented at OMV?
sec01-card-sec01-R26.teaching_text: A foreign driver license cannot stand alone without matching U.S. immigration documentation.

sec01-card-sec01-R27.question_text: Which three methods can verify a Social Security number during licensing?
sec01-card-sec01-R27.teaching_text: Louisiana allows the physical card, official Social Security Administration proof, or verbal verification when eligible.

sec01-card-sec01-R28.question_text: Which five school, police, workplace, or agency photo IDs appear on Louisiana's secondary list?
sec01-card-sec01-R28.teaching_text: Louisiana school badges, law-enforcement IDs, qualifying work badges, and agency or correctional IDs count secondary.

sec01-card-sec01-R29.question_text: On which document list do a TWIC card and a DHS employment-authorization card appear?
sec01-card-sec01-R29.teaching_text: Port and refinery workers often carry a TWIC card, which serves alongside DHS work cards as secondary ID.

sec01-card-sec01-R30.question_text: What authentication features and day limit govern a Refugee Resettlement Program letter used as secondary ID?
sec01-card-sec01-R30.teaching_text: Wait past day fifteen from issuance and that signed, raised-seal resettlement letter expires for OMV use.

sec01-card-sec01-R31.question_text: How does Louisiana classify high-school, college, or university diplomas, certificates, and licenses?
sec01-card-sec01-R31.teaching_text: An original high-school or college diploma helps round out the two-secondary-documents option.

sec01-card-sec01-F18.question_text: Through what age must a custodial parent or legal guardian sign for a minor's license, duplicate, or restriction change?
sec01-card-sec01-F18.teaching_text: Every OMV visit—initial card, replacement card, or restriction tweak—requires a parent or guardian signature until eighteen.

sec01-card-sec01-F19.question_text: Whose identification is checked at the counter when a minor applies with a parent or guardian?
sec01-card-sec01-F19.teaching_text: Bringing all the teen's documents still stalls if the signing parent forgets their own identification.
sec01-card-sec01-F19.must_match_memory_hook: Both minor and parent show ID

visual_sync.text_span: Both minor and parent show ID

sec01-card-sec01-F20.question_text: When divorced or separated parents share joint custody, which parent is authorized to sign the minor's application?
sec01-card-sec01-F20.teaching_text: Joint custody does not let either parent sign; Louisiana restricts signing authority strictly to the domiciliary parent.

sec01-card-sec01-F21.question_text: Beyond IDs and signatures, what court paperwork must accompany a custody-case minor's application?
sec01-card-sec01-F21.teaching_text: OMV clerks verify who holds domiciliary or custodial authority directly from the custody paperwork.

sec01-card-sec01-F27.question_text: What training requirement must every first-license applicant complete and prove before applying?
sec01-card-sec01-F27.teaching_text: Showing up to apply for a first Louisiana license without your completed course certificate stops the process.

sec01-card-sec01-F28.question_text: Which three testing or driving milestones require getting a Temporary Instruction Permit beforehand?
sec01-card-sec01-F28.teaching_text: Students obtain their Temporary Instruction Permit at OMV before sitting for knowledge, skills, or behind-the-wheel lessons.

sec01-card-sec01-F29.question_text: What minimum age and program path apply to a Class E learner-permit applicant?
sec01-card-sec01-F29.teaching_text: Class E learner permits open at fifteen and step sequentially through Louisiana's graduated licensing stages.

sec01-card-sec01-R01.question_text: When a green card dates past July nineteen ninety-seven, which ID tier applies and what pairs with it?
sec01-card-sec01-R01.teaching_text: Newer permanent resident cards act as primary ID alongside Social Security verification and one secondary document.

sec01-card-sec01-R02.question_text: When a green card dates earlier than July nineteen ninety-seven, how does your document checklist shift?
sec01-card-sec01-R02.teaching_text: Older pre-July-nineteen-ninety-seven cards count only as secondary ID, meaning you still need a separate primary document.

sec01-card-sec01-R03.question_text: Which four items make up the foreign-passport substitution when an arrival record was surrendered for permanent residence?
sec01-card-sec01-R03.teaching_text: Pairing that stamped passport with an employment-authorization card, SSN proof, and a secondary document completes identity.

sec01-card-sec01-R04.question_text: How fresh must the permanent-resident processing stamp be in that foreign-passport substitution?
sec01-card-sec01-R04.teaching_text: Once that passport processing stamp passes nine months old, OMV will no longer issue from it.

sec01-card-sec01-R05.question_text: What pairs with an application to adjust to lawful permanent residence on the guide's ID list?
sec01-card-sec01-R05.teaching_text: Applicants adjusting status pair their adjustment filing with Social Security verification and a secondary document.

sec01-card-sec01-R06.question_text: Is the vintage I-one-hundred-fifty-one resident-alien card still valid proof at OMV?
sec01-card-sec01-R06.teaching_text: Federal authorities retired the old I-151 resident-alien card decades ago, so OMV never accepts it.

sec01-card-sec01-R07.question_text: What required and recommended documents apply to a refugee seeking a Louisiana credential?
sec01-card-sec01-R07.teaching_text: Bring the refugee arrival record and two secondary documents, plus any available passport and work card.

sec01-card-sec01-R08.question_text: How long is an original Refugee Resettlement Program letter bearing a color photo accepted?
sec01-card-sec01-R08.teaching_text: Resettlement letters serve as short-bridge proof, expiring strictly fifteen days after their issuance date.

sec01-card-sec01-R09.question_text: Which four items appear on the document checklist for a nonimmigrant applicant?
sec01-card-sec01-R09.teaching_text: Nonimmigrants present a foreign passport, status-showing arrival record, Social Security proof, and one secondary document.

sec01-card-sec01-R10.question_text: What three school facts must appear on the student document presented by an F-one, J-one, or M-one holder?
sec01-card-sec01-R10.teaching_text: International students bring the official form naming their institution, program dates, and designated school official contact.

sec01-card-sec01-R11.question_text: At least how many days of remaining visa or arrival-record validity are needed to get a Louisiana card?
sec01-card-sec01-R11.teaching_text: Walking into OMV with twenty-nine or fewer days left on your arrival record results in denial.

sec01-card-sec01-R12.question_text: Can someone who is not a resident of Louisiana obtain a Louisiana driver license or ID card?
sec01-card-sec01-R12.teaching_text: State credentials require genuine Louisiana residency; visitors drive on home-state cards instead.

sec02-card-sec02-F01.question_text: Which three school-photo, transcript, or report-card options qualify on Louisiana's secondary document list?
sec02-card-sec02-F01.teaching_text: Using report cards requires at least two cards drawn from two different school years.

sec02-card-sec02-F02.question_text: How do an original or certified professional license, professional degree, or driver-ed certificate rank on the ID list?
sec02-card-sec02-F02.teaching_text: Your completed driver-education certificate doubles nicely as one of your secondary identity documents.

sec02-card-sec02-F03.question_text: On which document tier do Medicare, Medicaid, and medical-eligibility cards appear?
sec02-card-sec02-F03.teaching_text: Government health-benefit and medical-eligibility cards help round out secondary proof alongside primary ID.

sec02-card-sec02-F04.question_text: Which three adoption, church, or Louisiana land-ownership records appear as secondary-document examples?
sec02-card-sec02-F04.teaching_text: Even a Louisiana burial-plot deed or title counts alongside original adoption papers and baptismal certificates.

sec02-card-sec02-F05.question_text: Which three car-ownership or loan records qualify as secondary identification?
sec02-card-sec02-F05.teaching_text: Having a car titled, registered, or financed in your own name supplies one secondary document.

sec02-card-sec02-F06.question_text: Which two utility documents showing your name and address count on the secondary list?
sec02-card-sec02-F06.teaching_text: Brand-new renters who lack a monthly bill yet can bring the utility hookup receipt instead.

sec02-card-sec02-F07.question_text: Which four types of personal insurance policies qualify on Louisiana's secondary-document list?
sec02-card-sec02-F07.teaching_text: Active health, homeowner, life, or auto policy paperwork all count toward secondary identification.

sec02-card-sec02-F08.question_text: What paycheck document—or how many years of wage-and-tax forms—qualifies as secondary ID?
sec02-card-sec02-F08.teaching_text: Either one printed payroll stub or two separate years of W-2 wage-and-tax forms satisfies this item.

sec02-card-sec02-F09.question_text: Which three correctional, probation, or state-placement records appear on the secondary list?
sec02-card-sec02-F09.teaching_text: Returning citizens and agency-placed residents can use release papers, probation letters, or state placement proof.

sec02-card-sec02-F10.question_text: Besides identity, lawful status, birth date, and SSN proof, how many home-address documents does a first REAL ID require?
sec02-card-sec02-F10.teaching_text: Bringing only one utility bill stalls REAL ID enrollment because federal standards demand two principal-address proofs.

sec02-card-sec02-F11.question_text: Under what condition is a graduated learner-permit holder allowed to drive?
sec02-card-sec02-F11.teaching_text: Solo trips on a graduated learner permit are illegal regardless of distance or daylight.

sec02-card-sec02-F12.question_text: Which two factors does the Louisiana guide link directly to elevated teenage crash risk?
sec02-card-sec02-F12.teaching_text: Graduated stages add supervised practice and curfews while new drivers build judgment and seat time.

sec02-card-sec02-F13.question_text: In what exact three-stage order does Louisiana's graduated licensing system progress?
sec02-card-sec02-F13.teaching_text: Every teen climbs from supervised learner to curfew-restricted intermediate before earning full privileges.

sec02-card-sec02-F14.question_text: What is the minimum age to enter the first stage of Louisiana graduated licensing?
sec02-card-sec02-F14.teaching_text: Fourteen-year-olds cannot hold a Louisiana graduated learner permit; eligibility begins on birthday fifteen.

sec02-card-sec02-F15.question_text: How many classroom hours and behind-the-wheel instruction hours make up the learner-stage course?
sec02-card-sec02-F15.teaching_text: Memorize the thirty-plus-eight split because Louisiana tests those exact thirty-eight teen driver-ed hours.

sec02-card-sec02-F16.question_text: Which two examinations must a learner-stage applicant pass?
sec02-card-sec02-F16.teaching_text: Road-skills testing waits until the intermediate upgrade, while the learner stage checks eyes and written rules.

sec02-card-sec02-F17.question_text: Which two age-and-relationship options qualify someone to supervise a learner-stage driver?
sec02-card-sec02-F17.teaching_text: An eighteen-year-old friend cannot supervise you, whereas a licensed brother or sister aged eighteen-plus can.

sec02-card-sec02-F18.question_text: What permit-holding period and birthday milestone are required to step up from learner to intermediate?
sec02-card-sec02-F18.teaching_text: Turning sixteen early does not skip the calendar; you still owe a full one hundred eighty learner days.

sec02-card-sec02-F19.question_text: How many total and nighttime practice hours must a parent or guardian attest to for a sixteen-year-old's intermediate license?
sec02-card-sec02-F19.teaching_text: Notice those fifty attested practice hours—with fifteen after dark—must be driven with a licensed twenty-one-plus adult or parent.

sec02-card-sec02-F20.question_text: What prior stage and minimum age are prerequisites for Louisiana's intermediate stage?
sec02-card-sec02-F20.teaching_text: Sixteen-year-olds cannot jump straight into an intermediate license without finishing the supervised learner stage first.

sec02-card-sec02-F21.question_text: What minimum percentage score is required on the road-skills exam to earn an intermediate license?
sec02-card-sec02-F21.teaching_text: Eighty percent is Louisiana's universal passing bar across both the written knowledge exam and road skills.

sec02-card-sec02-F22.question_text: Between which overnight hours is an intermediate driver barred from driving solo, and who can accompany them?
sec02-card-sec02-F22.teaching_text: From eleven at night until five in the morning, bring a licensed twenty-one-plus adult or eighteen-plus sibling.

sec02-card-sec02-F23.question_text: Between six in the evening and five in the morning, how many non-family passengers under twenty-one may an intermediate driver carry?
sec02-card-sec02-F23.teaching_text: Notice the passenger cap kicks in five hours earlier than curfew—starting at six p.m. for non-sibling peers.

sec02-card-sec02-F24.question_text: Until what birthday must a teen maintain the intermediate license?
sec02-card-sec02-F24.teaching_text: Curfew and evening peer caps stay attached to your license all the way to your seventeenth birthday.

sec02-card-sec02-F25.question_text: Which two pathways lead to an unrestricted full Louisiana driver license?
sec02-card-sec02-F25.teaching_text: Graduating through learner and intermediate—or applying for the first time at seventeen or older—opens full licensing.

sec02-card-sec02-F26.question_text: What two course options let an eighteen-or-older newcomer apply for a Class E license or learner permit?
sec02-card-sec02-F26.teaching_text: Adults eighteen and up can take six classroom pre-licensing hours plus eight driving hours instead of thirty-eight.

sec02-card-sec02-F27.question_text: What financial protection must cover every motor vehicle operated on Louisiana highways?
sec02-card-sec02-F27.teaching_text: Operating an uninsured car without an approved financial-responsibility substitute violates state compulsory-coverage law.

sec02-card-sec02-F28.question_text: When OMV issues your driver license, what must you show if you own any vehicles?
sec02-card-sec02-F28.teaching_text: Applicants who already own a car in their name must present active liability proof at issuance.

sec02-card-sec02-F29.question_text: Which six specific details must appear on acceptable Louisiana proof of auto insurance?
sec02-card-sec02-F29.teaching_text: Check that your card lists the insurer's NAIC code alongside policy number, dates, car, and named insured.
sec02-card-sec02-F29.must_match_memory_hook: Insurer, policy, dates, car, insured, NAIC

visual_sync.text_span: Insurer, policy, dates, car, insured, NAIC

sec02-card-sec02-F30.question_text: Where must your vehicle's insurance card be kept?
sec02-card-sec02-F30.teaching_text: Leaving the active insurance card in a kitchen drawer instead of the car fails roadside verification.

sec02-card-sec02-F31.question_text: Which three screenings or tests can a Louisiana driver-license application involve?
sec02-card-sec02-F31.teaching_text: OMV checks that you can see clearly, know Louisiana law, and control a car safely in traffic.

sec02-card-sec02-F32.question_text: During which two credential transactions does OMV screen your eyesight?
sec02-card-sec02-F32.teaching_text: Both brand-new permit or license applicants and returning renewal drivers take the vision check.

sec02-card-sec02-F33.question_text: Does passing the OMV counter vision screening count as a medical eye examination?
sec02-card-sec02-F33.teaching_text: The counter machine checks only minimum driving acuity, never eye health or disease like an optometrist.

sec02-card-sec02-F34.question_text: What minimum visual-acuity standard does the Louisiana guide state for safe driving?
sec02-card-sec02-F34.teaching_text: Drivers must read at least the twenty-over-forty line—with or without corrective lenses—to clear screening.

sec02-card-sec02-F35.question_text: What happens if an applicant does not pass OMV's vision screening?
sec02-card-sec02-F35.teaching_text: OMV hands you a vision report form for an optometrist or ophthalmologist to evaluate and sign.

sec02-card-sec02-F36.question_text: If you need glasses or contacts to pass OMV's vision check, what rule attaches to your driving?
sec02-card-sec02-F36.teaching_text: Driving bare-eyed when your license requires corrective lenses counts as violating a license restriction.

sec02-card-sec02-F37.question_text: Which numeric restriction code on a Louisiana license signifies corrective lenses?
sec02-card-sec02-F37.teaching_text: Officers glancing at restriction code one on your card expect to see glasses or contacts on you.

sec02-card-sec02-F38.question_text: How do you get the corrective-lens restriction removed after laser eye surgery?
sec02-card-sec02-F38.teaching_text: Keep wearing lenses legally or visit an OMV office to pass an unaided vision check first.

sec02-card-sec02-F39.question_text: Which four subject areas appear on every first-time applicant's knowledge exam?
sec02-card-sec02-F39.teaching_text: Studying only road signs leaves you exposed on traffic signals, safe-driving habits, and state statutes.

sec02-card-sec02-F40.question_text: What question format does the knowledge test use, and where does every question come from?
sec02-card-sec02-F40.teaching_text: Every single multiple-choice prompt pulls straight from facts taught inside Louisiana's official guide.

sec02-card-sec02-F41.question_text: How is the knowledge examination delivered at most Louisiana offices?
sec02-card-sec02-F41.teaching_text: Expect a touchscreen or desktop computer terminal rather than paper-and-pencil bubbles at most branches.

sec02-card-sec02-F42.question_text: What percentage of questions must you answer right to pass the knowledge examination?
sec02-card-sec02-F42.teaching_text: Missing more than one out of every five questions drops you below the eighty-percent passing line.

sec02-card-sec02-F43.question_text: What must you bring every single time you sit for the knowledge examination?
sec02-card-sec02-F43.teaching_text: Even on a retest visit, showing up without proper identification keeps you out of the testing terminal.

sec02-card-sec02-F44.question_text: At least how many times does the guide advise reading the manual before taking the written exam?
sec02-card-sec02-F44.teaching_text: Skimming once misses fine numbers; reading the guide three full times cements Louisiana's exact thresholds.

sec02-card-sec02-F45.question_text: What test-taking habit does the guide recommend before tapping your answer?
sec02-card-sec02-F45.teaching_text: Grabbing Choice A before reading Choices B, C, and D falls right into half-true distractors.

sec02-card-sec02-F46.question_text: How early before an office's final testing cutoff does the guide advise arriving?
sec02-card-sec02-F46.teaching_text: Showing up at least an hour ahead of final testing time protects against check-in queues.

sec02-card-sec02-R01.question_text: How long does a standard Louisiana driver license run before expiring?
sec02-card-sec02-R01.teaching_text: Louisiana sets standard expiration six years out, anchored to your nearest birthday.

sec02-card-sec02-R02.question_text: How many days ahead of expiration can you request a Louisiana license renewal?
sec02-card-sec02-R02.teaching_text: Opening the renewal window one hundred eighty days early gives you roughly six months to plan.

sec02-card-sec02-R03.question_text: What screening is required before a driver license can be renewed?
sec02-card-sec02-R03.teaching_text: OMV verifies your eyesight still meets safe-driving standards before issuing a renewed cycle.

sec02-card-sec02-R04.question_text: When should you inspect a newly issued license for spelling, address, or restriction typos?
sec02-card-sec02-R04.teaching_text: Catching a typo at the counter gets fixed on the spot instead of requiring another trip.

sec02-card-sec02-R05.question_text: Why might an immigrant, nonimmigrant, or refugee receive a different license expiration date than six years?
sec02-card-sec02-R05.teaching_text: Credential end dates can match federal authorized-stay records rather than running the full six-year cycle.

sec02-card-sec02-R06.question_text: How long after discharge do valid Louisiana licenses stay good for out-of-state Armed Forces or Peace Corps members and dependents?
sec02-card-sec02-R06.teaching_text: As long as the license was valid upon entering service outside Louisiana, sixty post-discharge days apply.

sec02-card-sec02-R07.question_text: On which exact day after discharge does that military or Peace Corps license turn expired and delinquent?
sec02-card-sec02-R07.teaching_text: Day sixty is your final valid grace day; day sixty-one flips the card into delinquent status.

sec02-card-sec02-R08.question_text: Which two items renew a license under the military or Peace Corps service-extension rule?
sec02-card-sec02-R08.teaching_text: Presenting your last Louisiana license alongside official discharge papers proves you qualify for the extension.

sec02-card-sec02-R09.question_text: What age cap and license classes qualify a resident to be selected for mail or internet renewal?
sec02-card-sec02-R09.teaching_text: Drivers seventy and older—or holding commercial classes—renew in person rather than by mail or web.
sec02-card-sec02-R09.must_match_memory_hook: Under seventy, Class D or E

visual_sync.text_span: Under seventy, Class D or E

sec02-card-sec02-R10.question_text: Can OMV invite you to renew by mail or internet for two renewals in a row?
sec02-card-sec02-R10.teaching_text: Alternating remote renewals with branch visits ensures an updated vision screen and fresh photo.

sec02-card-sec02-R11.question_text: If OMV sends you a mail or online renewal invitation, are you forced to renew remotely?
sec02-card-sec02-R11.teaching_text: Remote renewal is a convenience option, so you can always walk into an office instead.

sec02-card-sec02-R12.question_text: Within how many days after moving must you update the address on your Louisiana license?
sec02-card-sec02-R12.teaching_text: Ten days passes fast—much tighter than the thirty-day new-resident window—so update your address right away.

sec02-card-sec02-R13.question_text: Which three certified records can authorize changing the legal name on your Louisiana license?
sec02-card-sec02-R13.teaching_text: Marriage certificates, birth certificates restoring a birth name, or court orders must all be certified.

sec02-card-sec02-R14.question_text: What fee applies when you change the name on your license mid-cycle between renewals?
sec02-card-sec02-R14.teaching_text: Updating your card between six-year renewals prints a replacement credential and charges the duplicate fee.

sec02-card-sec02-R15.question_text: Where do you apply to replace a lost, stolen, or destroyed Louisiana driver license?
sec02-card-sec02-R15.teaching_text: Replacing missing or damaged plastic takes an in-person visit to a motor-vehicle office.

sec02-card-sec02-R16.question_text: Who must appear with ID and custody papers to sign for a minor's duplicate license—especially in joint custody?
sec02-card-sec02-R16.teaching_text: Even for a lost wallet card, minors need their custodial signer—strictly the domiciliary parent under joint custody.

sec02-card-sec02-R17.question_text: What vehicle-coverage proof is required when applying for a duplicate license?
sec02-card-sec02-R17.teaching_text: If any vehicle is registered to you, bring current liability-insurance proof even for a replacement license.

sec02-card-sec02-R18.question_text: Which two authorities can place driving restrictions onto your Louisiana license?
sec02-card-sec02-R18.teaching_text: Restrictions—from glasses to ignition interlocks or daylight-only—can originate from either OMV or a judge.

sec02-card-sec02-R19.question_text: What legal consequence can follow driving in violation of a restriction printed on your license?
sec02-card-sec02-R19.teaching_text: Ignoring a printed restriction code breaks state law and can suspend your license outright.

sec02-card-sec02-R20.question_text: Which two groups of first-time license applicants must bring a detailed physician or vision-specialist report?
sec02-card-sec02-R20.teaching_text: Brand-new Louisiana applicants past age sixty—or with physical impairments—must submit specialist medical clearance upfront.

sec02-card-sec02-R21.question_text: Where do you get the required medical-report form, and what must the doctor describe on it?
sec02-card-sec02-R21.teaching_text: Handwritten doctor notes won't work; pick up OMV's official medical form covering safety-affecting conditions.

sec02-card-sec02-R22.question_text: What reports or exams may OMV require of any driver when safety questions arise?
sec02-card-sec02-R22.teaching_text: Whenever safe-driving fitness comes into question, OMV can order medical or vision reports plus written or road tests.

sec02-card-sec02-R23.question_text: How long do ordinary traffic convictions and crashes stay on public OMV records versus DWI convictions?
sec02-card-sec02-R23.teaching_text: DWI convictions—including out-of-state ones—stay twice as long on your public record at ten full years.

sec02-card-sec02-R24.question_text: What does a Louisiana identification card prove, and does it let you drive?
sec02-card-sec02-R24.teaching_text: A state ID card looks official in your wallet, yet sitting behind the wheel with only an ID is unlicensed driving.

sec02-card-sec02-R25.question_text: Which two core requirements apply to anyone seeking a Louisiana identification card?
sec02-card-sec02-R25.teaching_text: Non-drivers still prove full identity and a valid Louisiana home address to get a state ID.

sec02-card-sec02-R26.question_text: Which four revocation, training, testing, or age conditions make someone ineligible for a Louisiana license?
sec02-card-sec02-R26.teaching_text: Active revocation, unfinished driver ed, unpassed exams, or being fourteen and younger all block licensing.

sec02-card-sec02-R27.question_text: What happens to your driving privileges if you alter a license, misuse it, or lie on an application?
sec02-card-sec02-R27.teaching_text: Tampering with birthdates, lending out your card, or hiding material application facts strips driving rights.

sec02-card-sec02-R28.question_text: What happens to your license if you fail to stop and help after an injury or fatal crash?
sec02-card-sec02-R28.teaching_text: Fleeing a wreck where someone is hurt or killed triggers loss of driving privileges alongside criminal peril.

sec02-card-sec02-R29.question_text: How do either a DWI conviction or refusing chemical alcohol testing after a DWI arrest affect your license?
sec02-card-sec02-R29.teaching_text: Under implied-consent rules, refusing the breath or blood test after a DWI arrest still costs driving privileges.

sec02-card-sec02-R30.question_text: What blood-alcohol percentages trigger license loss for drivers twenty-one-plus versus drivers under twenty-one?
sec02-card-sec02-R30.teaching_text: Under-twenty-one drivers hit license loss at just zero point zero two percent—one-fourth the adult limit.
sec02-card-sec02-R30.must_match_memory_hook: Point zero eight adult; zero-two underage

visual_sync.text_span: Point zero eight adult; zero-two underage

sec02-card-sec02-R31.question_text: What license penalty can hit a driver who fails to stop for a school bus loading or unloading kids?
sec02-card-sec02-R31.teaching_text: Blowing past a stopped school bus endangers children and puts your license on the chopping block.

sec02-card-sec02-R32.question_text: How do vehicle manslaughter, negligent homicide, or any felony committed using a vehicle affect your license?
sec02-card-sec02-R32.teaching_text: Using a motor vehicle in any felony—or causing negligent homicide or manslaughter—costs your license.

sec02-card-sec02-R33.question_text: How many reckless-driving convictions inside twelve months can strip your driving privileges?
sec02-card-sec02-R33.teaching_text: Racking up three reckless-driving convictions within a single twelve-month span triggers privilege loss.

sec02-card-sec02-R34.question_text: Which four court-appearance, restriction, insurance, or suspension violations can cost driving privileges?
sec02-card-sec02-R34.teaching_text: Skipping court dates, breaking restrictions, dropping financial responsibility, or driving suspended snowballs fast.

sec02-card-sec02-R35.question_text: When does a traffic violation committed in another state jeopardize your Louisiana license?
sec02-card-sec02-R35.teaching_text: Crossing state lines hides nothing; any offense that suspends or revokes in Louisiana follows you home.

sec02-card-sec02-R36.question_text: Which two unpaid family or state-revenue obligations can cost your Louisiana driving privileges?
sec02-card-sec02-R36.teaching_text: Even a spotless driving record can be suspended over delinquent child support or unpaid Louisiana income taxes.

sec02-card-sec02-R37.question_text: What school-enrollment or truancy issues can affect driving privileges for fifteen- through seventeen-year-olds?
sec02-card-sec02-R37.teaching_text: Teens aged fifteen through seventeen who quit school before graduating or rack up habitual absences risk license action.

sec02-card-sec02-R38.question_text: Does waste have to be thrown out on purpose to count as littering in Louisiana?
sec02-card-sec02-R38.teaching_text: Trash blowing out of an open window or pickup bed is still illegal littering even when accidental.

sec02-card-sec02-R39.question_text: Which three categories of littering does the Louisiana guide distinguish?
sec02-card-sec02-R39.teaching_text: Penalties climb steeply from accidental simple littering to deliberate tossing and large-scale gross illegal dumping.

sec02-card-sec02-R40.question_text: What four roadway consequences can result when unsecured loads shed debris onto traffic?
sec02-card-sec02-R40.teaching_text: A loose ladder or mattress tumbling onto an interstate triggers chain-reaction swerves and fatal wrecks.

sec02-card-sec02-R41.question_text: How many pieces of roadside litter did the cited two thousand twenty-three Keep Louisiana Beautiful study find?
sec02-card-sec02-R41.teaching_text: Surveying over one hundred forty-three point eight million pieces shows how fast tiny wrappers accumulate statewide.

sec02-card-sec02-R42.question_text: What share of Louisiana roadside litter comes from motorists, pickups, garbage trucks, and unsecured loads?
sec02-card-sec02-R42.teaching_text: Nearly four out of every five pieces of roadside trash come straight off moving vehicles and open beds.

sec02-card-sec02-R43.question_text: Which item topped the study as the most littered small item, and which was the most visible roadside item?
sec02-card-sec02-R43.teaching_text: Keep that pair distinct for test day—cigarette butts lead small count while plastic water bottles stand out visibly.
sec02-card-sec02-R43.must_match_memory_hook: Cigarette butts smallest; bottles most visible

visual_sync.text_span: Cigarette butts smallest; bottles most visible

sec02-card-sec02-R44.question_text: How many roadside plastic items did the study count, and at what share of surveyed sites did water bottles appear?
sec02-card-sec02-R44.teaching_text: Over sixty-one point nine million plastic items littered roadsides, with water bottles turning up at four in five sites.

sec02-card-sec02-R45.question_text: How does roadside trash reach bayous and rivers, and what percentage of land litter ends up in waterways?
sec02-card-sec02-R45.teaching_text: Storm runoff and wind sweep four-fifths of land-tossed trash straight into Louisiana's bayous, lakes, and Gulf.

sec02-card-sec02-R46.question_text: What three environmental harms do discarded cigarette butts cause across water, wildlife, and land?
sec02-card-sec02-R46.teaching_text: Plastic-fiber filters leach toxic chemicals into water, poison birds and fish, and spark dry grass fires.

sec02-card-sec02-R47.question_text: What types of court proceedings can follow either accidental or deliberate littering?
sec02-card-sec02-R47.teaching_text: Claiming trash blew out accidentally still leaves you exposed to civil fines or criminal court action.

sec02-card-sec02-R48.question_text: Compare first-offense and second-offense penalties—in dollars or community-service hours—for simple littering?
sec02-card-sec02-R48.teaching_text: Notice the sixfold fine jump from one hundred fifty dollars on offense one to nine hundred on offense two.
sec02-card-sec02-R48.must_match_memory_hook: One-fifty or eight; nine-hundred or twenty

visual_sync.text_span: One-fifty or eight; nine-hundred or twenty

sec02-card-sec02-R49.question_text: Who is held legally responsible if a passenger tosses litter out the window or trash blows from the truck bed?
sec02-card-sec02-R49.teaching_text: Saying your backseat friend threw the cup won't dodge the ticket because responsibility lands on the driver.

sec02-card-sec02-R50.question_text: What must you do with a loaded pickup truck bed before driving?
sec02-card-sec02-R50.teaching_text: Tarping or strapping cargo down stops highway wind from whipping loose debris out of open beds.

sec02-card-sec02-R51.question_text: Which five details belong in a litter report, and what safety rule governs making the call?
sec02-card-sec02-R51.teaching_text: Pull safely into a parking spot before phoning in the vehicle description, plate, date, time, and location.

sec02-card-sec02-R52.question_text: How much does Louisiana spend every year cleaning up and preventing litter?
sec02-card-sec02-R52.teaching_text: Ninety-one point four million public dollars go toward picking up roadside trash every single year.

sec02-card-sec02-R53.question_text: Which six economic, drainage, wildlife, and community problems does the guide trace to litter?
sec02-card-sec02-R53.teaching_text: Trash-clogged storm drains worsen Louisiana street flooding while depressing home values, business, tourism, and wildlife.
sec02-card-sec02-R53.must_match_memory_hook: Values, tourism, clogged drains, flooding, wildlife

visual_sync.text_span: Values, tourism, clogged drains, flooding, wildlife

sec02-card-sec02-R54.question_text: What three cabin, passenger, and truck-bed habits stop vehicle litter at the source?
sec02-card-sec02-R54.teaching_text: Holding trash until you reach a bin, setting ground rules for riders, and securing beds eliminates roadside waste.
sec02-card-sec02-R54.must_match_memory_hook: Bag trash, curb passengers, secure beds

visual_sync.text_span: Bag trash, curb passengers, secure beds

sec02-card-sec02-R55.question_text: What simple item should a smoker keep in the vehicle instead of flicking butts out a window?
sec02-card-sec02-R55.teaching_text: Using a sealed portable car ashtray keeps toxic filters and live embers off roadsides.

sec08-card-sec08-F01.question_text: Where should you aim your gaze while driving instead of staring right off your front bumper?
sec08-card-sec08-F01.teaching_text: Staring right off your hood leaves zero reaction margin when traffic stacks up ahead.

sec08-card-sec08-F02.question_text: How many seconds ahead along your intended path does Louisiana's guide recommend scanning?
sec08-card-sec08-F02.teaching_text: Scanning a third to half a minute ahead previews lane closures and red lights effortlessly.

sec08-card-sec08-F03.question_text: What two adjustments should you make whenever a hill, curve, or tall truck blocks your forward view?
sec08-card-sec08-F03.teaching_text: Hidden asphalt beyond a crest or box truck could hold stopped traffic or road debris.

sec08-card-sec08-F04.question_text: Which three forward vehicle movements should your distant scan actively watch for?
sec08-card-sec08-F04.teaching_text: Catching driveway pull-outs, lane drifts, and turners early lets you tap the gas off smoothly.

sec08-card-sec08-F05.question_text: What early traffic clue do illuminated brake lights several cars ahead give you?
sec08-card-sec08-F05.teaching_text: Looking past the bumper right in front of you catches chain-reaction braking seconds sooner.

sec08-card-sec08-F06.question_text: How should you approach a green traffic light that has already been shining for a long while?
sec08-card-sec08-F06.teaching_text: Assuming an old green phase will flip before you arrive prevents panic braking or red-light running.

sec08-card-sec08-F07.question_text: How do early, gradual speed or lane adjustments help motorists trailing behind you?
sec08-card-sec08-F07.teaching_text: Smooth deceleration spreads warning ripples gently backward instead of triggering rear-end pileups.

sec08-card-sec08-F08.question_text: How can you measure your actual visual-lead seconds while rolling down a road?
sec08-card-sec08-F08.teaching_text: Picking a distant overpass or sign and counting until you pass it verifies your real scan horizon.

sec08-card-sec08-F09.question_text: Roughly how many seconds and feet does reacting and stopping from sixty miles per hour take on good pavement?
sec08-card-sec08-F09.teaching_text: Traveling longer than an entire football field before halting proves why highway tailgating turns ugly fast.

sec08-card-sec08-F10.question_text: Under good conditions, about how many seconds and feet does reacting and stopping take at thirty miles per hour?
sec08-card-sec08-F10.teaching_text: Notice how doubling speed from thirty to sixty nearly triples total stopping footage.

sec08-card-sec08-F11.question_text: What safety requirement links how far ahead you can see with how fast you may travel?
sec08-card-sec08-F11.teaching_text: Outrunning your clear line of sight turns any hidden stall around a bend into an unavoidable crash.

sec08-card-sec08-F12.question_text: Beyond marked street corners, what everyday entrances count as intersections because traffic streams cross or merge?
sec08-card-sec08-F12.teaching_text: Treating shopping-plaza aprons and residential driveways like real junctions keeps pull-outs from surprising you.

sec08-card-sec08-F13.question_text: Approaching an intersection, which six elements does Louisiana's guide tell you to scan?
sec08-card-sec08-F13.teaching_text: Checking oncoming and cross cars, pedestrians, signs, sightlines, and slick pavement prevents tunnel vision.

sec08-card-sec08-F14.question_text: After halting at an intersection, in what exact order should you turn your head before pulling out?
sec08-card-sec08-F14.teaching_text: Cross traffic from the left reaches your driver's door first, earning both the opening and final check.

sec08-card-sec08-F15.question_text: Should you stop scanning cross streets just because cross traffic faces a red light or stop sign?
sec08-card-sec08-F15.teaching_text: Paint and bulbs never physically stop a distracted driver from blowing right through a cross street.

sec08-card-sec08-F16.question_text: What exit condition on the far side of an intersection must exist before you roll past the stop line?
sec08-card-sec08-F16.teaching_text: Pulling into backed-up traffic traps your tail across the box once the signal flips red.

sec08-card-sec08-F17.question_text: What scanning habit do busy sidewalks, schools, playgrounds, and parking lots demand?
sec08-card-sec08-F17.teaching_text: Distracted shoppers and darting kids step off curbs outside intersections without looking.

sec08-card-sec08-F18.question_text: Which two oncoming traffic movements outrank a driver waiting to turn left?
sec08-card-sec08-F18.teaching_text: Cutting across opposing lanes puts the burden on you to let both through cars and right-turners clear.

sec08-card-sec08-F19.question_text: What destination check prevents getting stranded broadside across oncoming lanes during a left turn?
sec08-card-sec08-F19.teaching_text: Starting left while pedestrians cross your target street stalls your car broadside across live oncoming lanes.

sec08-card-sec08-F20.question_text: Which three conflict sources must you scan before turning right at an intersection?
sec08-card-sec08-F20.teaching_text: Drivers staring solely left for gaps miss opposing left-turners or pedestrians stepping off the right curb.

sec08-card-sec08-F21.question_text: What speed and visual routine applies whenever you approach a railroad crossing?
sec08-card-sec08-F21.teaching_text: Trains or track-maintenance rigs can approach silently from either side even without flashing gates.

sec08-card-sec08-F22.question_text: Before which four driving situations does Louisiana's guide emphasize checking traffic behind you?
sec08-card-sec08-F22.teaching_text: Knowing who sits on your rear bumper shapes how early you brake, merge, or descend steep grades.

sec08-card-sec08-F23.question_text: What two rear hazards should your mirrors clear before you start changing lanes?
sec08-card-sec08-F23.teaching_text: A fast driver swinging out two cars back can fill your target gap before you move.

sec08-card-sec08-F24.question_text: How does the Louisiana guide define a vehicle's blind spots?
sec08-card-sec08-F24.teaching_text: Even well-aimed glass leaves pockets beside rear quarter panels large enough to hide a sedan or motorcycle.

sec08-card-sec08-F25.question_text: What physical check clears your blind spot right before changing lanes?
sec08-card-sec08-F25.teaching_text: A crisp chin-to-shoulder glance catches motorcycles and sedans tucked right beside your rear fender.

sec08-card-sec08-F26.question_text: What forward mistake must you avoid while checking mirrors or glancing over your shoulder?
sec08-card-sec08-F26.teaching_text: Staring backward for full seconds blinds you if the car ahead slams its brakes simultaneously.

sec08-card-sec08-F27.question_text: How many seconds of open traffic gap does Louisiana's guide recommend finding before changing lanes?
sec08-card-sec08-F27.teaching_text: Slipping into a four-to-five-second pocket preserves safe following cushions both ahead and behind.

sec08-card-sec08-F28.question_text: In order, what five steps complete a clean, legal lane change from blinker on to blinker off?
sec08-card-sec08-F28.teaching_text: Canceling your blinker afterward stops cross-street drivers ahead from thinking you plan a corner turn.

sec08-card-sec08-F29.question_text: When is checking your mirrors while braking especially critical to prevent a rear-end hit?
sec08-card-sec08-F29.teaching_text: Trailing drivers rarely anticipate mid-block braking where no intersection or traffic signal stands.

sec08-card-sec08-F30.question_text: Why should you monitor your mirrors closely while descending a long downhill grade?
sec08-card-sec08-F30.teaching_text: Heavy trucks gather momentum or suffer brake fade on long hills—spotting them early lets you clear out.

sec08-card-sec08-F31.question_text: How should your inside rearview mirror be aimed before you put the car in gear?
sec08-card-sec08-F31.teaching_text: Centering the full back glass gives the widest straight-back view without tilting your head.

sec08-card-sec08-F32.question_text: How should outside side-mirror views relate to your inside rearview mirror's coverage?
sec08-card-sec08-F32.teaching_text: Slight edge overlap hands passing cars smoothly from center glass into side glass with minimal gap.

sec08-card-sec08-F33.question_text: What slice of forward travel counts as perception distance?
sec08-card-sec08-F33.teaching_text: Even before your brain decides to brake, your car keeps rolling while your eyes process danger.

sec08-card-sec08-F34.question_text: Which span of travel defines reaction distance during an emergency stop?
sec08-card-sec08-F34.teaching_text: Moving your right foot from accelerator to brake pedal eats dozens of highway feet before pads clamp.

sec08-card-sec08-F35.question_text: What happens during the braking-distance portion of a stop?
sec08-card-sec08-F35.teaching_text: Once pads squeeze rotors, tire grip and road friction dictate how far momentum carries you.

sec08-card-sec08-F36.question_text: Which three distances add together to equal total stopping distance?
sec08-card-sec08-F36.teaching_text: Test questions often omit perception—remember all three segments combine before wheels stop turning.

sec08-card-sec08-F37.question_text: Besides driver response speed, what four physical factors change how much road you need to stop?
sec08-card-sec08-F37.teaching_text: Heavy cargo, bald tread, worn pads, or slick rain stretch stopping distance far beyond dry-chart estimates.

sec08-card-sec08-F38.question_text: What two dangerous outcomes climb sharply as vehicle speed rises?
sec08-card-sec08-F38.teaching_text: Kinetic energy squares with speed, stretching braking rollout while multiplying impact force if you hit.

sec08-card-sec08-F39.question_text: At what exact moment do you begin counting your three-second following check?
sec08-card-sec08-F39.teaching_text: Starting your count as their rear bumper passes a shadow or signpost gives an objective gap check.

sec08-card-sec08-F40.question_text: What does reaching that roadside marker before finishing a three-second count tell you?
sec08-card-sec08-F40.teaching_text: Arriving under three seconds means you lack baseline perception-and-reaction cushion on dry pavement.

sec08-card-sec08-F41.question_text: What should you do right after timing less than three seconds behind the car ahead?
sec08-card-sec08-F41.teaching_text: Dropping back slightly and counting a fresh marker confirms your new cushion truly clears three seconds.

sec08-card-sec08-R01.question_text: To how many seconds does Louisiana's guide expand your basic following interval on wet roads or in bad weather?
sec08-card-sec08-R01.teaching_text: Adding at least a fourth second offsets slick asphalt and rain-blurred brake lights ahead.

sec08-card-sec08-R02.question_text: How should you respond when another driver merges into your open following cushion?
sec08-card-sec08-R02.teaching_text: Lifting off the accelerator for two seconds restores your safety shield without touching brakes.

sec08-card-sec08-R03.question_text: Why must your following gap grow wider whenever pavement turns slick?
sec08-card-sec08-R03.teaching_text: Lower tire friction means even crisp anti-lock brakes roll much farther before stopping.

sec08-card-sec08-R04.question_text: What specific hazard explains leaving extra following room behind a motorcycle?
sec08-card-sec08-R04.teaching_text: Gravel patches, potholes, or slick paint stripes can spill a two-wheeled rider right in front of you.
sec08-card-sec08-R04.must_match_memory_hook: Extra room in case rider falls

visual_sync.text_span: Extra room in case rider falls

sec08-card-sec08-R05.question_text: For what two visibility reasons must you hang farther back behind a bus or box truck?
sec08-card-sec08-R05.teaching_text: Sitting right off trailer doors blinds you forward while burying your hood inside the trucker's rear no-zone.

sec08-card-sec08-R06.question_text: How does hitching a trailer behind your vehicle change stopping physics?
sec08-card-sec08-R06.teaching_text: Extra rolling mass pushes forward against your brakes, demanding wider cushions before every stop.

sec08-card-sec08-R07.question_text: How should darkness or poor visibility change the space you hold behind traffic ahead?
sec08-card-sec08-R07.teaching_text: Dim sightlines delay spotting unlit hazards or stalled vehicles until they sit much closer.

sec08-card-sec08-R08.question_text: Why must you hold extra distance behind fire trucks, ambulances, or patrol units?
sec08-card-sec08-R08.teaching_text: Emergency crews may brake sharply, swing wide into driveways, or deploy gear without warning.

sec08-card-sec08-R09.question_text: Which two vehicle classes should you expect to halt at railroad crossings—and trail with extra space?
sec08-card-sec08-R09.teaching_text: School buses and placarded tankers stop even when crossing gates stay up and unlit.

sec08-card-sec08-R10.question_text: Why should you leave extra bumper gap when halted behind another vehicle on an uphill incline?
sec08-card-sec08-R10.teaching_text: Manual-shift cars and heavy trucks often drift back a foot or two as clutches engage on green.

sec08-card-sec08-R11.question_text: Instead of wrestling a tight turnaround on a busy street, what route choice does the guide prefer?
sec08-card-sec08-R11.teaching_text: Four simple corner turns beat blocking two directions of fast traffic mid-block.

sec08-card-sec08-R12.question_text: Under what exact road conditions does Louisiana's guide allow a three-point turnabout?
sec08-card-sec08-R12.teaching_text: Three-point turns briefly place your doors broadside across lanes—use them only when safer options vanish.

sec08-card-sec08-R13.question_text: Should you set the parking brake only on hills, or on flat ground as well?
sec08-card-sec08-R13.teaching_text: Making the parking brake an automatic habit on flat lots and steep streets prevents rollaway surprises.

sec08-card-sec08-R14.question_text: In an automatic-transmission car, does setting the parking brake replace shifting into park?
sec08-card-sec08-R14.teaching_text: Using both mechanical brake cables and the transmission's park pawl gives redundant roll protection.

sec08-card-sec08-R15.question_text: In what foot-and-lever order should you secure an automatic car when parking?
sec08-card-sec08-R15.teaching_text: Setting the parking brake before shifting into park keeps heavy vehicle weight off the transmission pin.

sec08-card-sec08-R16.question_text: What brake step must happen before you pull out of a parking spot?
sec08-card-sec08-R16.teaching_text: Driving with the parking brake still engaged overheats rear pads and ruins stopping power.

sec08-card-sec08-R17.question_text: Which way must your front tires point when parking downhill next to a curb?
sec08-card-sec08-R17.teaching_text: Gravity pulls the nose forward on a downgrade, wedging right-turned tires straight against concrete.

sec08-card-sec08-R18.question_text: Which way must your front tires point when parking uphill beside a raised curb?
sec08-card-sec08-R18.teaching_text: If the car rolls backward uphill, outward-turned front tires catch the curb instead of drifting into lanes.

sec08-card-sec08-R19.question_text: With no curb present, which way should your parked wheels turn whether facing uphill or downhill?
sec08-card-sec08-R19.teaching_text: Without concrete to catch a tire, steering toward the shoulder sends any runaway roll off the road.

sec08-card-sec08-R20.question_text: Along with turned wheels, what two mechanical settings keep a hill-parked vehicle out of traffic?
sec08-card-sec08-R20.teaching_text: Combining parking brake tension with park—or low gear in a manual—locks the drivetrain redundantly.

sec08-card-sec08-R21.question_text: What four-part routine guides you smoothly into an angled parking stall?
sec08-card-sec08-R21.teaching_text: Leaving wide side clearance before turning in keeps your front corner from clipping adjacent bumpers.

sec08-card-sec08-R22.question_text: What all-around scan is mandatory before backing out of any parking stall?
sec08-card-sec08-R22.teaching_text: Shopping carts, toddlers, and cross-aisle cars approach from front, sides, and rear simultaneously.

sec08-card-sec08-R23.question_text: Why must you inch out at creeping speed when backing from between two parked vehicles?
sec08-card-sec08-R23.teaching_text: Tall pickups beside you hide cross-aisle traffic until half your trunk clears their bumpers.

sec08-card-sec08-R24.question_text: Which direction does your front bumper swing while steering through a reverse turn?
sec08-card-sec08-R24.teaching_text: Forgetting front-end swing scrapes your front fender right across the parked car beside you.

sec08-card-sec08-R25.question_text: Which two ways of entering a perpendicular parking stall does Louisiana's guide prefer when possible?
sec08-card-sec08-R25.teaching_text: Parking nose-out lets you drive forward into the aisle later with unobstructed windshield sightlines.

sec08-card-sec08-R26.question_text: Unless stall lines mark otherwise, at least how many feet should remain between parallel-parked bumpers?
sec08-card-sec08-R26.teaching_text: Leaving two feet fore and aft keeps neighboring cars from boxing you in against the curb.

sec08-card-sec08-R27.question_text: Which four visual clues warn that a curb-parked car is about to pull into your lane?
sec08-card-sec08-R27.teaching_text: Spotting white reverse bulbs or angled front tires lets you ease off or change lanes early.

sec08-card-sec08-R28.question_text: What three sudden hazards should you anticipate while driving beside a row of parked cars?
sec08-card-sec08-R28.teaching_text: Leaving a door-width buffer prevents clipping an unlatched door or a cyclist rolling out.

sec08-card-sec08-R29.question_text: Within how many inches of the right-hand curb must your right wheels rest when parallel parked?
sec08-card-sec08-R29.teaching_text: Parking wider than a foot and a half leaves your driver's side sticking dangerously into live lanes.

sec08-card-sec08-R30.question_text: What four security and safety steps are required before walking away from an unattended parked vehicle?
sec08-card-sec08-R30.teaching_text: Shutting down, pocketing keys, locking up, and setting the brake stops both rollaways and theft.
sec08-card-sec08-R30.must_match_memory_hook: Engine off, key out, lock, brake

visual_sync.text_span: Engine off, key out, lock, brake

sec08-card-sec08-R31.question_text: What must you check for before swinging open a traffic-side door?
sec08-card-sec08-R31.teaching_text: Flinging a street-side door into a bike lane causes severe dooring crashes in a split second.

sec08-card-sec08-R32.question_text: Which four everyday travel paths may you never block by parking?
sec08-card-sec08-R32.teaching_text: Parking across any of those four strips forces pedestrians, cyclists, or neighbors into live traffic.

sec08-card-sec08-R33.question_text: How many feet must you stay clear when parking near a fire hydrant versus a railroad crossing?
sec08-card-sec08-R33.teaching_text: Keep those two test favorites distinct—hydrants take fifteen feet while rail tracks demand fifty.

sec08-card-sec08-R34.question_text: Parking is banned within how many feet of an intersection crosswalk?
sec08-card-sec08-R34.teaching_text: Keeping twenty feet open at corners lets approaching drivers see adults, strollers, and kids waiting.

sec08-card-sec08-R35.question_text: How far from a fire-station driveway is parking banned on the same side versus across the street?
sec08-card-sec08-R35.teaching_text: Long ladder trucks need a wide seventy-five-foot arc across the opposite curb to swing out cleanly.

sec08-card-sec08-R36.question_text: Along with double-parking beside another car, which three highway structures ban parking altogether?
sec08-card-sec08-R36.teaching_text: Narrow spans without escape shoulders turn any parked vehicle into a high-speed bottleneck hazard.

sec08-card-sec08-R37.question_text: What two posted or active work-area rules bar parking on otherwise open curb space?
sec08-card-sec08-R37.teaching_text: Obstructing road crews or ignoring temporary tow-away signs stalls equipment and narrows work lanes.

sec08-card-sec08-R38.question_text: Within how many feet of a stop sign, yield sign, or roadside traffic signal is parking prohibited?
sec08-card-sec08-R38.teaching_text: A tall van parked closer than twenty feet hides stop signs completely from approaching drivers.

sec08-card-sec08-R39.question_text: How do white-painted curbs differ from yellow-painted curbs under Louisiana's guide?
sec08-card-sec08-R39.teaching_text: White curbs handle brief passenger drop-offs while yellow marks freight loading or special limits.

sec08-card-sec08-R40.question_text: What restrictions do red curb paint and blue curb paint signal?
sec08-card-sec08-R40.teaching_text: Red reserves curb access for fire emergencies while blue protects authorized disability parking.

sec08-card-sec08-R41.question_text: What purpose does the striped access aisle next to an accessible parking stall serve?
sec08-card-sec08-R41.teaching_text: Wheelchair ramps and side lifts need several open feet beside van doors to deploy onto pavement.

sec08-card-sec08-R42.question_text: Even for a one-minute errand, what is required to use an accessible parking space legally?
sec08-card-sec08-R42.teaching_text: Running inside briefly without valid plates or placard still steals essential access from someone who needs it.

sec08-card-sec08-R43.question_text: May shoppers leave shopping carts or park a narrow motorcycle inside a striped access aisle?
sec08-card-sec08-R43.teaching_text: Even a single stray cart or scooter wedges a wheelchair ramp shut and strands the neighboring driver.

sec08-card-sec08-R44.question_text: What immediate consequence can hit a vehicle parked illegally in an accessible stall or access aisle?
sec08-card-sec08-R44.teaching_text: Beyond heavy tickets, unauthorized cars parked on blue stalls or stripes get towed at owner expense.
