sec08-card-sec08-R45.question_text: What must a left-side pass never force either oncoming traffic or the overtaken driver to do?
sec08-card-sec08-R45.teaching_text: If oncoming headlights brake or hug the shoulder so you fit back in, that pass was illegal.

sec08-card-sec08-R46.question_text: Before closing within what distance of an oncoming vehicle must you finish passing and return right?
sec08-card-sec08-R46.teaching_text: At highway speeds two cars eat one hundred feet in under a second—be settled in your lane well before.

sec08-card-sec08-R47.question_text: Which three sightline, paint, or surface conditions forbid passing?
sec08-card-sec08-R47.teaching_text: Crests, bends, solid yellow stripes on your side, and roadside shoulders never offer legal passing space.

sec08-card-sec08-R48.question_text: Passing is barred within one hundred feet of which four roadway features?
sec08-card-sec08-R48.teaching_text: Side traffic, trains, and narrow bridge walls make swinging into opposing lanes inside one hundred feet deadly.

sec17-card-sec17-F01.question_text: Which two official ownership and road-use records does Louisiana require for a motor vehicle?
sec17-card-sec17-F01.teaching_text: Your title proves legal ownership on file, while current registration authorizes plates on public roads.

sec17-card-sec17-F02.question_text: At which two types of offices can you apply for a Louisiana title, registration, and license plate?
sec17-card-sec17-F02.teaching_text: Licensed public tag agents process titles and plates locally alongside state motor vehicle branches.

sec17-card-sec17-F03.question_text: How can the cost of using a licensed public tag agent differ from visiting an OMV office?
sec17-card-sec17-F03.teaching_text: Shorter lines at a private public tag agent can come with extra convenience fees above state charges.

sec17-card-sec17-F04.question_text: Which two origin and sale documents does a Louisiana new-car dealer provide?
sec17-card-sec17-F04.teaching_text: Because a brand-new car has never been titled before, the manufacturer's certificate of origin and notarized invoice start its record.

sec17-card-sec17-F05.question_text: How do dealerships usually handle sales taxes, fees, and filing for your title and plate?
sec17-card-sec17-F05.teaching_text: Most buyers drive off the lot while the dealership forwards taxes, fees, and title paperwork to OMV.

sec17-card-sec17-F06.question_text: How must a temporary dealer license plate be mounted or displayed on your car?
sec17-card-sec17-F06.teaching_text: Tucking a temp tag behind dark-tinted glass where nobody behind you can read it invites a traffic stop.

sec17-card-sec17-F07.question_text: What must the prior owner or used-car dealer do with the certificate of title when selling?
sec17-card-sec17-F07.teaching_text: Walking away with an unsigned or improperly assigned title blocks transferring ownership into your name.

sec17-card-sec17-F08.question_text: When must the seller hand over the properly assigned title on a vehicle sale?
sec17-card-sec17-F08.teaching_text: Never hand over cash on a promise that the seller will mail the signed title weeks later.

sec17-card-sec17-F09.question_text: If a used vehicle's title shows an existing lien, what must you verify before buying?
sec17-card-sec17-F09.teaching_text: Without an authorized lien release, the bank's unpaid loan claim stays attached to the car you just bought.

sec17-card-sec17-F10.question_text: Which notarized ownership paper and coverage statement appear on the guide's title-application list?
sec17-card-sec17-F10.teaching_text: Louisiana requires notarization on assigned titles alongside your declaration of liability coverage.

sec17-card-sec17-F11.question_text: When can you skip bringing a separate bill of sale during a Louisiana title transfer?
sec17-card-sec17-F11.teaching_text: Entering the selling price directly in the designated box on the title makes a separate bill of sale redundant.

sec17-card-sec17-F12.question_text: What extra document must accompany your title application if you financed the vehicle with a loan?
sec17-card-sec17-F12.teaching_text: Submitting the chattel mortgage paperwork records your lender's security interest on the new title.

sec17-card-sec17-F13.question_text: Where must you keep your vehicle's registration certificate, and when must you produce it?
sec17-card-sec17-F13.teaching_text: Keep the registration slip in the car—while storing your title safely at home—for roadside inspection.

sec17-card-sec17-F14.question_text: Where can you get a duplicate registration certificate if your original goes missing?
sec17-card-sec17-F14.teaching_text: Either a state motor vehicle office or a licensed public tag agent can print a replacement slip.

sec17-card-sec17-F15.question_text: What must a new Louisiana resident do for vehicles brought along from another state?
sec17-card-sec17-F15.teaching_text: Relocating to Louisiana requires switching both your driver license and your vehicle's title and plates.

sec17-card-sec17-F16.question_text: Which three out-of-state and coverage records start a new resident's Louisiana vehicle registration?
sec17-card-sec17-F16.teaching_text: Gathering your prior state's title, current registration slip, and valid insurance keeps the counter visit smooth.

sec17-card-sec17-F17.question_text: What does Louisiana accept when an out-of-state bank or lienholder is still holding your physical title?
sec17-card-sec17-F17.teaching_text: Unlike personal ID—where photocopies fail—an out-of-state lender holding your car title calls for a title photocopy.

sec17-card-sec17-F18.question_text: Why should a new resident bring proof of vehicle taxes already paid in the previous state?
sec17-card-sec17-F18.teaching_text: Showing tax receipts from your former state documents what you already paid when transferring into Louisiana.

sec17-card-sec17-R01.question_text: Within how many days after moving must you update the address on your vehicle registration?
sec17-card-sec17-R01.teaching_text: Ten days matches the exact same ten-day address-change clock required on your Louisiana driver license.

sec17-card-sec17-R02.question_text: What practical headache comes from leaving an old address on your vehicle registration?
sec17-card-sec17-R02.teaching_text: Mailed registration renewal invitations go to the last address on file and miss you if outdated.

sec17-card-sec17-R03.question_text: What financial-responsibility proof is required to obtain a Louisiana license plate?
sec17-card-sec17-R03.teaching_text: OMV will not issue a license plate without active liability insurance or a legal substitute.

sec17-card-sec17-R04.question_text: What two ongoing duties apply to insurance proof whenever a vehicle is driven?
sec17-card-sec17-R04.teaching_text: Active insurance on your phone app or paper card must ride in the car and be shown on request.

sec17-card-sec17-R05.question_text: What two immediate enforcement actions can hit your car if you cannot show proof of insurance?
sec17-card-sec17-R05.teaching_text: Driving without insurance proof can leave your license plate pulled roadside and your car towed to impound.

sec17-card-sec17-R06.question_text: What two penalties threaten someone who submits or shows false insurance information?
sec17-card-sec17-R06.teaching_text: Presenting a doctored or canceled insurance card escalates from a simple lapse into registration suspension and court action.

sec17-card-sec17-R07.question_text: Before dropping insurance on a car you are taking off the road, what must you turn in to OMV?
sec17-card-sec17-R07.teaching_text: Dropping insurance first triggers compulsory-insurance flags because OMV still sees an active plate on your car.

sec17-card-sec17-R08.question_text: What two date details printed on your registration certificate show when your plate expires?
sec17-card-sec17-R08.teaching_text: Glancing at the month and year on your registration slip confirms whether your plate sticker is current.

sec17-card-sec17-R09.question_text: To what address does the motor vehicle agency send a registration renewal invitation?
sec17-card-sec17-R09.teaching_text: OMV mails straight to whatever address sits in its database, reinforcing the ten-day move update rule.

sec17-card-sec17-R10.question_text: Which two remote channels can eligible vehicle owners use by following their renewal invitation?
sec17-card-sec17-R10.teaching_text: Using the renewal code on your mailed notice lets eligible owners renew online or by telephone.

sec17-card-sec17-R11.question_text: Whom must you notify if your registration renewal notice shows an error or outdated address?
sec17-card-sec17-R11.teaching_text: Correcting vehicle details or addresses directly with OMV keeps your renewed registration slip accurate.

sec17-card-sec17-R12.question_text: Does never receiving a mailed renewal reminder excuse driving on expired registration?
sec17-card-sec17-R12.teaching_text: Lost mail never beats an expired-tag ticket because keeping registration current rests strictly on the owner.

sec17-card-sec17-R13.question_text: What sign color and wording identify an authorized Louisiana motor vehicle inspection station?
sec17-card-sec17-R13.teaching_text: Look for the official orange sign naming a Louisiana motor vehicle inspection station when getting inspected.

sec17-card-sec17-R14.question_text: Which three Louisiana municipalities run their own separate vehicle inspection programs?
sec17-card-sec17-R14.teaching_text: Vehicles registered in New Orleans, Kenner, or Westwego follow local municipal brake-tag rules.

sec17-card-sec17-R15.question_text: Where should you check exact fees for commercial rigs, motorcycles, specialty plates, or plate transfers?
sec17-card-sec17-R15.teaching_text: Specialty, motorcycle, commercial, and transfer fee schedules vary, so check OMV's website or local branch.

sec10-card-sec10-F01.question_text: What right do bicyclists hold on Louisiana public roads, and what legal duty comes with it?
sec10-card-sec10-F01.teaching_text: Treating cyclists as guests instead of lawful traffic causes drivers to cut off riders at junctions.

sec10-card-sec10-F02.question_text: How must motorists treat a bicyclist when yielding right-of-way at an intersection?
sec10-card-sec10-F02.teaching_text: Rolling through a stop or turn ahead of an approaching bike violates intersection priority rules.

sec10-card-sec10-F03.question_text: Which surface conditions allow a bicyclist to move away from the roadway's right edge?
sec10-card-sec10-F03.teaching_text: Skinny tires can flip on broken asphalt or glass that a sedan rolls over without noticing.

sec10-card-sec10-F04.question_text: Where on the roadway may a bicyclist position when getting ready to make a left turn?
sec10-card-sec10-F04.teaching_text: Expecting a rider to turn left from the far-right gutter ignores lawful left-lane positioning.

sec10-card-sec10-F05.question_text: On a two-way street with oncoming traffic approaching, how must you handle passing a bicycle?
sec10-card-sec10-F05.teaching_text: Threading between an oncoming car and a cyclist leaves zero room if either vehicle drifts inches.

sec10-card-sec10-F06.question_text: At least how many feet of clearance must a passing motorist leave beside a slower bicycle?
sec10-card-sec10-F06.teaching_text: Buzzing past closer than three feet risks clipping handlebars or knocking a rider down with windblast.

sec10-card-sec10-F07.question_text: Why must you leave extra lateral space when a bicyclist rides alongside parked cars?
sec10-card-sec10-F07.teaching_text: Riders swing wide of curbed bumpers so a suddenly opened door never knocks them under your wheels.

sec10-card-sec10-F08.question_text: How should you adjust your clearance around a bicycle when your vehicle is towing a trailer?
sec10-card-sec10-F08.teaching_text: Trailers track wider and whip sideways over bumps long after your front bumper clears the rider.

sec10-card-sec10-F09.question_text: How do wind, rain, or ice affect a bicyclist, and what two adjustments should motorists make?
sec10-card-sec10-F09.teaching_text: Crosswinds and slick puddles destabilize two narrow wheels instantly, demanding lower speed and wider buffers.

sec10-card-sec10-F10.question_text: What must you do before turning left when a bicyclist is approaching from the opposite direction?
sec10-card-sec10-F10.teaching_text: Drivers misjudge narrow bicycle speed and cut left across oncoming riders who hold through right-of-way.

sec10-card-sec10-F11.question_text: Why must you never overtake a bicyclist and then immediately turn right?
sec10-card-sec10-F11.teaching_text: Cutting right just after passing slices straight across the cyclist's forward path with zero braking space.

sec10-card-sec10-F12.question_text: What check is required before swinging your parked vehicle's door open toward a travel lane?
sec10-card-sec10-F12.teaching_text: Dooring a cyclist at street speed throws the rider into either steel door edges or passing traffic.

sec10-card-sec10-F13.question_text: What sudden move should you anticipate when a bicyclist approaches railroad tracks or a metal grate?
sec10-card-sec10-F13.teaching_text: Riders angle across rails and slick bridge grates so narrow rims never drop into parallel slots.

sec10-card-sec10-F14.question_text: Why do children riding bicycles demand extra caution from nearby motorists?
sec10-card-sec10-F14.teaching_text: Young riders focus on pedaling fun rather than traffic signs and can dart sideways without warning.

sec10-card-sec10-F15.question_text: Under Louisiana's guide, which young cyclists must wear an approved, fitted, and fastened helmet?
sec10-card-sec10-F15.teaching_text: Test distractors swap twelve with sixteen, so lock in younger than twelve with straps fastened.

sec10-card-sec10-F16.question_text: How should bicyclists communicate maneuvers to traffic, and how must they treat signs and signals?
sec10-card-sec10-F16.teaching_text: Clear arm signals and predictable stops at red lights let drivers and cyclists share lanes smoothly.

sec10-card-sec10-F17.question_text: Where does a bicyclist normally ride relative to traffic flow, and when may the rider use the lane center?
sec10-card-sec10-F17.teaching_text: Claiming the center around hazards keeps riders upright and visible instead of pinched into broken curbs.

sec10-card-sec10-F18.question_text: Who holds priority when a bicyclist encounters pedestrians in a crosswalk or on a sidewalk?
sec10-card-sec10-F18.teaching_text: Even on two wheels without an engine, cyclists move faster than walkers and owe full pedestrian yield.

sec10-card-sec10-F19.question_text: Which front and rear visibility equipment does the guide require on a bicycle ridden at night?
sec10-card-sec10-F19.teaching_text: Matching vehicle lighting colors tells night drivers instantly whether a cyclist is approaching or riding ahead.

sec10-card-sec10-F20.question_text: How many riders may a bicycle legally carry on the road?
sec10-card-sec10-F20.teaching_text: Perching an extra friend on handlebars or pegs ruins steering balance and stretches stopping distances.

sec10-card-sec10-F21.question_text: Why do motorists often misjudge an approaching motorcycle's distance and closing speed?
sec10-card-sec10-F21.teaching_text: A slim single headlight looks farther off than dual car lamps, baiting drivers into premature turns.

sec10-card-sec10-F22.question_text: Why can a fast mirror check miss a nearby motorcycle completely?
sec10-card-sec10-F22.teaching_text: Roof pillars and door mirrors easily hide an entire motorcycle unless you turn your head twice.

sec10-card-sec10-F23.question_text: For what three safety reasons might a motorcyclist shift left or right inside a single lane?
sec10-card-sec10-F23.teaching_text: Smart riders adjust lane track to stay in car mirrors and avoid oil slicks without changing lanes.

sec10-card-sec10-F24.question_text: How do wind gusts, pavement defects, and track surfaces hit a motorcycle compared with a car?
sec10-card-sec10-F24.teaching_text: Potholes, grooved pavement, or crosswinds that barely nudge four tires can upset two-wheel traction fast.

sec10-card-sec10-F25.question_text: How much lane width belongs to a motorcycle, and may a car share that lane beside it?
sec10-card-sec10-F25.teaching_text: Crowding into a rider's lane steals the lateral escape room needed to dodge potholes or debris.

sec10-card-sec10-F26.question_text: How should you execute a pass around a motorcycle compared with passing another car?
sec10-card-sec10-F26.teaching_text: Squeezing past inside the rider's own lane blasts the bike with air turbulence inches from handlebars.

sec10-card-sec10-F27.question_text: Why is it risky to pull out solely because an approaching motorcycle's turn signal is flashing?
sec10-card-sec10-F27.teaching_text: Older or manual motorcycle indicators keep blinking after lane changes, fooling cross-street drivers into crashes.

sec10-card-sec10-F28.question_text: When is it safe to pull across an approaching motorcycle's path at an intersection?
sec10-card-sec10-F28.teaching_text: Watching actual deceleration and lean angle proves a real turn far better than a blinking bulb.

sec10-card-sec10-F29.question_text: At least how many seconds of following distance does Louisiana's guide call for behind a motorcycle?
sec10-card-sec10-F29.teaching_text: Motorcycles can stop sharper than sedans and riders may spill on gravel, requiring four full seconds.

sec10-card-sec10-F30.question_text: How should you manage high-beam headlights when meeting or following a motorcycle at night?
sec10-card-sec10-F30.teaching_text: High-beam glare blinds a helmet visor or small bike mirror even worse than a sedan windshield.

sec10-card-sec10-R01.question_text: How do a large truck's stopping and maneuvering space needs compare with a passenger car's?
sec10-card-sec10-R01.teaching_text: Longer wheelbases and heavy freight multiply both turning sweep and braking distance across every maneuver.

sec10-card-sec10-R02.question_text: Why must you avoid darting into the open gap left directly in front of a moving truck?
sec10-card-sec10-R02.teaching_text: That empty buffer ahead of the rig is deliberate braking distance, not an invitation to merge short.

sec10-card-sec10-R03.question_text: What happens to visibility when a small car sits tight against the nose of a long-hooded truck?
sec10-card-sec10-R03.teaching_text: High cab seats looking over tall radiator hoods create a blind pocket right off the front bumper.

sec10-card-sec10-R04.question_text: What rule applies to lingering alongside a large truck inside its side blind zone?
sec10-card-sec10-R04.teaching_text: Camping next to trailer axles leaves you invisible if the rig swerves around debris or merges.

sec10-card-sec10-R05.question_text: What warning applies whenever you cannot see the truck driver's face in the rig's mirror?
sec10-card-sec10-R05.teaching_text: Sightlines work identically both ways off flat glass, so missing the driver's face confirms you vanished.

sec10-card-sec10-R06.question_text: What adjustment must you make if you follow a truck so closely that its side mirrors disappear?
sec10-card-sec10-R06.teaching_text: Tucking tight behind trailer doors blinds you to road hazards ahead and hides you from cab mirrors.

sec10-card-sec10-R07.question_text: Why must you give a turning semi-truck extra clearance throughout its corner?
sec10-card-sec10-R07.teaching_text: As cab and trailer hinge at an angle, mirror views swing away from adjacent lanes mid-turn.

sec10-card-sec10-R08.question_text: Why should you stop farther back behind a heavy truck waiting on an uphill grade?
sec10-card-sec10-R08.teaching_text: Heavy manual rigs can drift back several feet as the driver releases brakes to engage gears.

sec10-card-sec10-R09.question_text: Why should you minimize time spent next to a large truck in windy weather?
sec10-card-sec10-R09.teaching_text: Strong gusts buffet tall box trailers laterally and create sudden wind pockets as you pass the cab.

sec10-card-sec10-R10.question_text: How should you hold the steering wheel while passing a large truck, and why?
sec10-card-sec10-R10.teaching_text: High-speed air pushed off a semi's nose and tail tugs lighter passenger cars sideways mid-pass.

sec10-card-sec10-R11.question_text: Which three everyday highway actions take a large truck noticeably longer than a passenger car?
sec10-card-sec10-R11.teaching_text: Sixty-foot length and heavy tonnage mean every speed change and overtaking pass stretches much farther downroad.

sec10-card-sec10-R12.question_text: In good weather and dry pavement, how many seconds should you keep behind a large truck?
sec10-card-sec10-R12.teaching_text: Four to five seconds opens your forward sightlines around wide trailers and cushions sudden debris.

sec10-card-sec10-R13.question_text: How must your following gap behind a truck change when weather or pavement turns poor?
sec10-card-sec10-R13.teaching_text: Wet pavement stretches your own braking distance while heavy dual tires kick up blinding road mist.

sec10-card-sec10-R14.question_text: What two visibility advantages do you gain by trailing farther behind a large truck?
sec10-card-sec10-R14.teaching_text: Dropping back lets you see traffic signals past the trailer and stays clear of dirty tire mist.

sec10-card-sec10-R15.question_text: Which headlight setting belongs on when following a truck at night, and why?
sec10-card-sec10-R15.teaching_text: High beams reflect off oversized cab mirrors and blind the trucker watching lanes ahead.

sec10-card-sec10-R16.question_text: What do truck mudguards cut down on, and what wet-weather hazard do they fail to stop?
sec10-card-sec10-R16.teaching_text: Counting on rubber mudflaps to stop rain mist leaves drivers unprepared for sudden windshield whiteouts.

sec10-card-sec10-R17.question_text: Which two vehicle items must stay in top shape when sharing rainy roads with trucks?
sec10-card-sec10-R17.teaching_text: Oily road film thrown by eighteen tires smears across dirty glass if worn wiper blades streak.

sec10-card-sec10-R18.question_text: What should you do right before meeting an oncoming truck in the rain?
sec10-card-sec10-R18.teaching_text: Turning wipers up before a rig passes clears the wall of water instantly instead of driving blind.

sec10-card-sec10-R19.question_text: What visibility condition must be met before you pull out to pass a large truck?
sec10-card-sec10-R19.teaching_text: Overtaking a long trailer takes far more road than passing a sedan, leaving zero room for guesswork.

sec10-card-sec10-R20.question_text: How do you lessen the blinding effect of wheel spray thrown off a nearby truck?
sec10-card-sec10-R20.teaching_text: Adding space lets heavy tire mist settle back onto asphalt before hitting your windshield.

sec10-card-sec10-R21.question_text: Around which four sides of a large truck do No-Zones hide nearby vehicles?
sec10-card-sec10-R21.teaching_text: Test takers remember side and rear blind spots easily while forgetting the hidden pocket up front.

sec10-card-sec10-R22.question_text: On which side does Louisiana's guide direct motorists to pass a large truck?
sec10-card-sec10-R22.teaching_text: A semi's right-side blind spot stretches much longer and wider than the driver's left-mirror view.

sec10-card-sec10-R23.question_text: After passing a semi-truck, what must show in your rearview mirror before pulling back ahead?
sec10-card-sec10-R23.teaching_text: Waiting for both headlights and bumper in your center mirror preserves safe stopping distance behind you.

sec10-card-sec10-R24.question_text: Why should highway drivers give an entering semi-truck generous room to merge?
sec10-card-sec10-R24.teaching_text: Heavy freight keeps acceleration gradual on short entrance ramps, so easing off or shifting left prevents pinch points.

sec10-card-sec10-R25.question_text: Why is watching a large vehicle's turn signal critical when it moves slightly left near an intersection?
sec10-card-sec10-R25.teaching_text: Drivers who ignore a right blinker mistake that initial left setup swing for a left-lane move.

sec10-card-sec10-R26.question_text: Where must you never position your car when a truck or bus is making a right turn?
sec10-card-sec10-R26.teaching_text: Trailer rear wheels cut tight across the right lane and crush cars wedged beside the curb.

sec10-card-sec10-R27.question_text: When may you start turning at an intersection next to a turning truck or bus?
sec10-card-sec10-R27.teaching_text: Holding back until trailer axles clear the corner prevents off-tracking sweeps from clipping your hood.
